# year as numeric mAUC=0.686 
check.model.performance = function(predicted.class, actual.class){
  
  result.tbl = as.data.frame(table(as.character(predicted.class),as.character(actual.class))) 
  colnames(result.tbl)[1:2] = c("Pred","Truth")
  print(result.tbl)
  control = 0  
  ##MACRO averaging here
  for (class in unique(result.tbl$Truth) ){
    control = control + 1
    print(class)
    tp = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Pred==class & result.tbl$Truth==class, "Freq"])
    tpandfp = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Pred == class , "Freq" ]) #TP plus FP
    fp = tpandfp - tp
    tpandfn = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Truth == class , "Freq" ]) #TP plus FN
    fn = tpandfn - tp
    tn = sum(result.tbl[result.tbl$Truth != class & result.tbl$Pred != class, "Freq"])
    print(tn)
    presi = tp/tpandfp 
    rec = tp/tpandfn
    accuracy = (tp + tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn)
    spec = tn/(tn + fp)
    F.score = 2*presi*rec/(presi+rec)
    MCC = ((tp*tn)-(fn*fp))/sqrt((tp+fn)*(tn+fp)*(tp+fp)*(tn+fn))
    if (control == 1 ) metrics = tibble(class = as.character(class), 
                                        presi = as.numeric(presi),
                                        recall = as.numeric(rec),
                                        accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
                                        spec = as.numeric(spec),
                                        F.score = as.numeric(F.score),
                                        MCC = as.numeric(MCC))
    if (control > 1 ) metrics = rbind(metrics,c(as.character(class), as.numeric(presi), as.numeric(rec), as.numeric(accuracy), as.numeric(spec), as.numeric(F.score), as.numeric(MCC)))
  }
  
  return(metrics)
}

#cvnest function, p is not used for glmnet predictions
cvnested = function(data.frame, truth.frame, k, p){ #data.frame to train on, k is for outter fold, p is for inner fold
  print(ncol(data.frame))
  flds <- createFolds(1:ncol(data.frame), k = k, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  auc = c()
  predict.values.df = data.frame("11"=c(), "12"=c(), "14"=c(), "15"=c(), "17"=c())
  truth.values = c()
  #print(length(flds))
  for (i in 1:length(flds)){#outter
    test.outter = data.frame[, c(flds[[i]])]
    truth.test.outter = truth.frame$year[c(flds[[i]])]
    #print(truth.test.outter)
    #print(flds[[i]])
    train.outter = data.frame[, -c(flds[[i]])] 
    truth.train.outter = truth.frame$year[-c(flds[[i]])]
    fraction = table(truth.train.outter)/length(truth.train.outter)
    weights = 1 - fraction[as.character(truth.train.outter)]
    #print(truth.train.outter)
    #print(dim(train.outter))
    #cv.glmnet takes care of inner loop training
    cvglmfit = cv.glmnet(x = t(train.outter),
                         y = (truth.train.outter),
                         family = "gaussian", weights = weights)
    s0 = cvglmfit$lambda.1se
    #hyper-parameter
    #fit train dataset with given hyper-parameter
    glmfit = glmnet(x = t(train.outter),
                    y = (truth.train.outter),
                    family = "gaussian")
    #predict on testing dataset
    pred = predict(glmfit, t(test.outter),
                   type = "response", s = s0)
    pred.values = predict(glmfit, t(test.outter),
                          type = "response", s = s0)
    pred.values.df = data.frame(pred.values)
    colnames(pred.values.df) = c("year")
    predict.values.df = rbind(predict.values.df, pred.values.df)
    
    pred <- as.data.frame(apply(pred, 2, round))
    
    truth.values=c(truth.values, truth.test.outter)
    confusion_table = table(predicted = pred[,1], truth = (truth.test.outter))
    #print(confusion_table)
    mROC = multiclass.roc((truth.test.outter), (pred[,1]))
    #print(auc(mROC))
    auc = c(auc, mROC$auc)
    #test model selected by inner to the outter test set
  }#outter
  #print(dim(predict.values.df))
  #print(rownames(predict.values.df))
  #print(truth.values) #this is not necessary as the truth remains to be the truth
  #reodering the dataframe to be consistent between resamplings.
  predict.values.df = predict.values.df[order(rownames(predict.values.df)),]
  
  #fit build model on whole dataset and testing on external dataset
  fraction = table(truth.frame$year)/length(truth.frame$year)
  weights = 1 - fraction[as.character(truth.frame$year)]
  cvglmfit.final = cv.glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                             y = (truth.frame$year),
                             family = "gaussian", weights = weights)
  s0.model = cvglmfit.final$lambda.1se
  glmfit.final = glmnet(x = t(data.frame),
                        y = (truth.frame$year),
                        family = "gaussian")
  #use on external dataset
  # print(paste0("the s0 used is ", s0.model))
  pred.all = predict(glmfit.final, t(data.frame), type = "response", s=s0.model)
  
  pred.all <- as.data.frame(apply(pred.all, 2, round))
  confusion_table.all = table(predicted = (pred.all[,1]), truth = (truth.frame$year))
  print(confusion_table.all)
  metrics = check.model.performance((pred.all[,1]),(truth.frame$year))
  #print(metrics)
  mROC.all = multiclass.roc((truth.frame$year), (pred.all[,1]))
  print(mROC.all$auc)
  return(list(auc = auc, metrics=metrics, predict.values=predict.values.df))
}

##multiclass auc

#use bind_cols and bind_rows for tibbles
cal_auc = function(finalvalues, finaltruth, zero_label, one_label){
  #zero_label="spring"
  #one_label="summer"
  colnames(finalvalues) = c("spring", "summer", "fall", "winter")
  final.df = bind_cols(truth=finaltruth, finalvalues)
  points = tibble(label=character(), prob=double())
  for (i in 1:dim(final.df)[1]){
    if (final.df$truth[i] == zero_label | final.df$truth[i] == one_label){
      #print(as.character(final.df$truth[i]))#
      #print(as.double(final.df[i, zero_label]))
      points = bind_rows(points, tibble(label = as.character(final.df$truth[i]), prob = as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label])))
    }
  }
  #print(dim(points))
  colnames(points) = c("label", "zero_label_prob")
  #sorted by prob values, then we get ranks
  points = points[order(points$zero_label_prob),]
  #print(points)
  #class(points)
  n0 = 0
  n1 = 0
  sum_ranks = 0
  #i is rank here
  for (i in 1:dim(points)[1]){
    if (points$label[i] == zero_label) {
      n0 = n0 + 1
      sum_ranks = sum_ranks + i
    }
    if (points$label[i] == one_label){
      n1 = n1 + 1
    }
  }
  #print(n0)
  #print(n1)
  #print(sum_ranks)
  
  return((sum_ranks - (n0*(n0+1)/2.0)) / (n0 * n1))
}

cal_auc(finalvalues, finaltruth, "spring", "winter") 

#function generating all possible combinations from a vector, store in data.frame
combinations = function(vector){
  combos = tibble(a=character(), b=character())
  for (i in 1:(length(vector)-1)){
    for (j in (i+1):length(vector)){
      #slice = c(as.character(vector[i]), as.character(vector[j]))
      #names(slice) = c("a", "b")
      #print(vector[j])
      combos = bind_rows(combos, c(a = as.character(vector[i]), b= as.character(vector[j])))
    }
  }
  #print(combos)
  return(combos)
}

seasons = c("spring","summer", "fall", "winter")

combos = combinations(seasons)

#calculating mAUC values
#combos is the combinations between two labels
cal_mAUC = function(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos){
  colnames(finalvalues) = c("spring", "summer", "fall", "winter")
  sums = 0
  mAUC = 0
  for (i in 1:dim(combos)[1]){
    sums = sums + (cal_auc(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos$a[i], combos$b[i]) + cal_auc(finalvalues, finaltruth, combos$b[i], combos$a[i]))/2
  }
  mAUC = sums * 2 / (length(seasons) * (length(seasons)-1))
  return(mAUC)
}

#one vs all method
cal_roc_ova = function(finalvalues, finaltruth, zero_label){
  #zero_label="spring"
  #one_label="summer"
  colnames(finalvalues)=c("spring","summer","fall","winter")
  final.df = bind_cols(truth=finaltruth, finalvalues)
  points = data.frame(label=character(), prob=double())
  for (i in 1:dim(final.df)[1]){
    if (final.df$truth[i] == zero_label){
      #print(as.character(final.df$truth[i]))#
      #print(as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label]))
      points = rbind(points, c(label = as.character(final.df$truth[i]), prob = as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label])))
    } else {
      points = rbind(points, c(0, prob = as.numeric(final.df[i, zero_label])))
    }}
  #print(dim(points))
  colnames(points) = c("label", "zero_label_prob")
  #sorted by prob values, then we get ranks
  points = points[order(points$zero_label_prob),]
  points$label=factor(points$label, levels =c(zero_label, 0))
  points$zero_label_prob = as.numeric(points$zero_label_prob)
  return(points)
}

#weights calcualted by percentage of sum of absolute coefficients(weight)
weights = list(spring =c(), summer=c(), fall=c(), winter=c())

select_taxo = function(season) {
  se = season
  coefs = coef(glmfit)[[se]][, which.min(abs(glmfit$lambda - s0))]
  coefs = sort(coefs, decreasing= TRUE)
  print(se)
  #print(head(coefs,4))
  #print(tail(coefs,4))
  weights[[se]] = c(abs(coefs[coefs != 0])/sum(abs(coefs[coefs != 0]))*100)
  selecttaxons[[se]] = c(coefs[abs(coefs) >0])
  return(list(season=se, weights=weights, selecttaxo=selecttaxons[[se]]))
}

```{r dbrda-variation-partitioning}
library(vegan)

#metabolite
species <-  read.delim('/Users/chenqiong/Desktop/replot/metabolite_ymy/si_metabo.txt',

env <- read.delim('/Users/chenqiong/Desktop/replot/metabolite_ymy/full_pred_si_glm_update.txt',
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1,header = T,
                  sep = "\t")
species <- species[,-c(1:3)]
env <- env[,-c(1:3)]

tech <- data.frame(env[,48])
Env <- data.frame(env[,c(1:37)])
time <- data.frame(env[,38:47])

species_hel <- decostand(species, method = 'hellinger')

rda.data = species_hel

#rda forward selections of every group, using AEM variables (through RDA axes)
mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, tech) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., tech) #model with all variables
step.res.tech = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 2.3% explained

mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, Env) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., Env) #model with all variables
step.res.Env = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 10.3% explained
step.forward.Env = forward.sel(rda.data, Env)

mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, time) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., time) #model with all variables
step.res.time = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 7.13% explained
step.forward.time = forward.sel(rda.data, time)

mod0 = rda(rda.data ~ 1, time) #model with intercept only
mod1 = rda(rda.data ~., time) #model with all variables
step.res.time = ordiR2step(mod0, mod1, perm.max =1000) #about 10.49% explained
time.R2a = RsquareAdj(mod1)$adj.r.squared
step.forward.time = forward.sel(rda.data, time, adjR2thresh = time.R2a)

#vegan variable selection procedure for every group, for dbRDA (used in paper)
#using AEM variables
mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist="bray", data=tech, add=TRUE)
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist="bray", data=tech, add=TRUE)
step.res.db.tech = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000) #about % explained      

# tech.select.db = tech[, attributes(step.res.db.tech$terms)$term.labels]

colnames(tech) = "batch"
tech.select.db = tech

mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist="bray", data=Env, add=TRUE)
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist="bray", data=Env, add=TRUE)
step.res.db.Env = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000) #about % explained   
Env.select.db = Env[, attributes(step.res.db.Env$terms)$term.labels]
Env.select.db


mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist="bray", data=time, add=TRUE)
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist="bray", data=time, add=TRUE)
step.res.db.time = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000) #about % explained   
time.select.db = time[, attributes(step.res.db.time$terms)$term.labels]
time.select.db
#combining all for variable selection
allfactors = cbind(tech, Env, time) 

mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist = "bray", data = allfactors) #using add = TRUE option will give different results, more variables
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist = "bray", data = allfactors)
step.res.db.all = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000, pin = 0.05) #about % explained  
all.select.db = allfactors[, attributes(step.res.db.all$terms)$term.labels]
all.select.db

  #takes output from rcorr function, adjusting p value matrix accroding to fdr principles
  matrixPadjust = function(res, select = c(1:nrow(res$P))){
    print(select)
    temp.p = c(res$P)
    temp.p[is.na(temp.p)] = 0
    temp.p.adj = p.adjust(temp.p, method = "fdr")
    p.adj.matrix = matrix(temp.p.adj, nrow = ncol(res$P), ncol=ncol(res$P), dimnames = list(rownames = colnames(res$P), colnames = colnames(res$P)))
    return(p.adj.matrix)
  }
  adjusted.res2.p = matrixPadjust(res2)
  #pls package also has a function called corrplot

    #using calc.relimp from the relaimpo package, no limitation on the number of testing variables imposed
    
    cicalc = function(delta, ref){ #90% confidence interval
      delta = sort(delta)
      range = quantile(delta, c(0.05, 0.95))
      ratio.ci = as.numeric(ref) - as.numeric(c(range[2], range[1]))
      names(ratio.ci) = c("5%", "95%")
      names(ref) = "reference"
      return(c(ref, ratio.ci))
    }
    
    ecdf_fun = function(x,perc) {ecdf(x)(perc)} #retrun percentile given value in a distribution
    
    
    #This part takes a lot of time, about 20 hours, result is saved as a rds object
    relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(nrow=3))
    relaimp.rsq = c()
    relaimp.adjrsq = c()
    relaimp.p = c()
    relaimp.var.y = c()
    ratio.master = list()
    
    #si
    for (name in as.character(input$X[input$padjust<0.05])){ #only on genera that occured in more than 100 samples
      #name="Stereum"
      print(name)
      lm.fit = lm(rda.data[,name]~., data=all.select.db)
      lm.rela = calc.relimp(lm.fit, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE, groups = list(spa=c(8,9,13)+1,env= c(1,2,3,4,5,6,10,11,12)+1,tech=c(7)+1)) #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
      #group 1 is env, group 2 is spa, group 3 is tech
      reference.temp = lm.rela@lmg
      #relaimp.df = cbind(relaimp.df, lm.rela@lmg)
      relaimp.var.y = c(relaimp.var.y, lm.rela@var.y)
      lm.summary = summary(lm.fit)
      relaimp.rsq = c(relaimp.rsq, lm.summary$r.squared)
      relaimp.adjrsq = c(relaimp.adjrsq, lm.summary$adj.r.squared)
      refratio = reference.temp[1]/reference.temp[2]
      refenv = reference.temp[1]
      refloc = reference.temp[2]
      reftech = reference.temp[3]
      
      data.slice = rda.data[,name]
      set.seed = 123
      bootstrapping.matrix = replicate(200, sample(1:114, 114, replace = TRUE)) #each COLUMN is a sampling
      relaimp.df.temp = data.frame(matrix(nrow=3))
      #relaimp.var.y.temp = c()
      for (i in 1:ncol(bootstrapping.matrix)){
        #print(i)
        rda.data.temp = data.slice[bootstrapping.matrix[,i]]
        all.select.db.temp = all.select.db[bootstrapping.matrix[,i],]
        lm.fit.temp = lm(rda.data.temp~., data=all.select.db.temp)
        lm.rela.temp = calc.relimp(lm.fit.temp, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE, groups = list(spa=c(8,9,13)+1,env= c(1,2,3,4,5,6,10,11,12)+1,tech=c(7)+1))  #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
        relaimp.df.temp = cbind(relaimp.df.temp, lm.rela.temp@lmg)
        #relaimp.var.y.temp = c(relaimp.var.y.temp, lm.rela.temp@var.y)
      }
      relaimp.df.temp = relaimp.df.temp[,-1]
      resample.ratio = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[1,]/relaimp.df.temp[2,])
      resample.env = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[1,])
      resample.loc = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[2,])
      resample.tech = unlist(relaimp.df.temp[3,])
      
      deltaratio = refratio - resample.ratio
      deltaenv =refenv - resample.env
      deltaloc = refloc - resample.loc
      deltatech = reftech - resample.tech
      
      #range = quantile(deltaratio.sort, c(0.05, 0.95))
      #ratio.ci = as.numeric(refratio) - as.numeric(c(range[2], range[1]))
      #names(ratio.ci) = c("5%", "95%")
      #names(refratio) = "reference"
      #ratio.ci
      ratio.master[[name]] = data.frame(ratio = cicalc(deltaratio, refratio),
                                        env = cicalc(deltaenv, refenv),
                                        loc = cicalc(deltaloc, refloc),
                                        tech = cicalc(deltatech, reftech),
                                        onequantile = ecdf_fun(resample.ratio,1) #quantile of probability of env/loc <= 1
      )
    }
```

```{r Ks_and_total_carbon_prediction}
## fast gbrm


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(gbm)
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
})

run_gbm_oof_with_importance <- function(df, target_col="type", K=10,
                                        ntrees=2000, depth=7, shrink=0.01,
                                        bag_frac=0.6, min_node=10,
                                        top_n=30, seed=1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # numeric only + target
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  num_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  df <- df[, num_cols, drop=FALSE]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df), , drop=FALSE]
  
  folds <- createFolds(df[[target_col]], k = K, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  
  pred_oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  imp_list <- vector("list", K)
  
  for (k in seq_along(folds)) {
    test_idx  <- folds[[k]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), test_idx)
    
    train_df <- df[train_idx, , drop=FALSE]
    test_df  <- df[test_idx,  , drop=FALSE]
    
    m <- gbm(
      formula = as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
      data = train_df,
      distribution = "gaussian",
      n.trees = ntrees,
      cv.folds = 0,
      shrinkage = shrink,
      interaction.depth = depth,
      bag.fraction = bag_frac,
      n.minobsinnode = min_node,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    pred_oof[test_idx] <- predict(m, newdata = test_df, n.trees = ntrees, type = "response")
    
    imp <- summary(m, n.trees = ntrees, plotit = FALSE)  # contains var + rel.inf
    imp$fold <- k
    imp_list[[k]] <- imp[1:min(top_n, nrow(imp)), c("var", "rel.inf", "fold")]
    
    cat("Fold", k, "done\n")
  }
  
  y <- df[[target_col]]
  resid <- y - pred_oof
  RMSE <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  R2   <- 1 - sum(resid^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  cor_pear <- cor.test(pred_oof, y, method="pearson")
  
  imp_df <- bind_rows(imp_list)
  imp_sum <- imp_df %>%
    group_by(var) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rel_inf = mean(rel.inf),
      freq = n(),                 # 出现在top_n的fold次数，<=K
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_rel_inf))
  
  list(
    pred = data.frame(y=y, pred=pred_oof),
    RMSE = RMSE,
    R2 = R2,
    cor = cor_pear,
    importance_raw = imp_df,
    importance_summary = imp_sum
  )
}

# 全模型+top 30因子 #

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(gbm)
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
})

# 核心函数：给定数据+特征集合，做10-fold OOF + 输出fold明细 
run_gbm_oof <- function(df, target_col,
                        feature_cols = NULL,
                        K = 10,
                        ntrees = 2000, depth = 3, shrink = 0.01,
                        bag_frac = 0.6, min_node = 10,
                        top_n = 30, seed = 1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  stopifnot(target_col %in% colnames(df))
  
  # 只用数值列（gbm需要数值/有序因子，这里直接强制数值以免出坑）
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  num_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  df2 <- df[, num_cols, drop = FALSE]
  df2 <- df2[complete.cases(df2), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # feature_cols 为空：用所有除target外的列
  if (is.null(feature_cols)) {
    feature_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df2), target_col)
  } else {
    feature_cols <- intersect(feature_cols, colnames(df2))
  }
  
  # 组装建模数据
  model_df <- df2[, c(target_col, feature_cols), drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(!(target_col %in% feature_cols))
  
  folds <- createFolds(model_df[[target_col]], k = K, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)
  
  pred_oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(model_df))
  
  # 保存每个fold的预测明细（你要的 test_y / pred_y）
  fold_pred_list <- vector("list", K)
  
  # 保存每个fold的topN importance（用于第一阶段挑top30）
  imp_list <- vector("list", K)
  
  for (k in seq_along(folds)) {
    test_idx  <- folds[[k]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(model_df)), test_idx)
    
    train_df <- model_df[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    test_df  <- model_df[test_idx,  , drop = FALSE]
    
    m <- gbm(
      formula = as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
      data = train_df,
      distribution = "gaussian",
      n.trees = ntrees,
      cv.folds = 0,
      shrinkage = shrink,
      interaction.depth = depth,
      bag.fraction = bag_frac,
      n.minobsinnode = min_node,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    pred <- predict(m, newdata = test_df, n.trees = ntrees, type = "response")
    pred_oof[test_idx] <- pred
    
    fold_pred_list[[k]] <- data.frame(
      fold = k,
      row_id = test_idx,                 # 在model_df内的行号（可用于回填/对齐）
      y = test_df[[target_col]],
      pred = pred
    )
    
    imp <- summary(m, n.trees = ntrees, plotit = FALSE)
    imp$fold <- k
    imp_list[[k]] <- imp[1:min(top_n, nrow(imp)), c("var", "rel.inf", "fold")]
    
    cat("Fold", k, "done\n")
  }
  
  # OOF性能
  y <- model_df[[target_col]]
  resid <- y - pred_oof
  RMSE <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  R2   <- 1 - sum(resid^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  cor_pear <- cor.test(pred_oof, y, method="pearson")
  
  # 汇总importance（第一阶段会用到）
  imp_df <- bind_rows(imp_list)
  imp_sum <- imp_df %>%
    group_by(var) %>%
    summarise(mean_rel_inf = mean(rel.inf),
              freq = n(),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_rel_inf))
  
  # 组装OOF逐样本结果（带fold）
  fold_pred <- bind_rows(fold_pred_list) %>%
    arrange(row_id)
  
  oof_pred <- data.frame(
    y = y,
    pred = pred_oof
  )
  
  list(
    model_df = model_df,                 # 想看最终进模型的数据
    feature_cols = feature_cols,
    pred_oof = oof_pred,                 # 全样本OOF预测（无fold）
    fold_pred = fold_pred,               # 每fold的test_y/pred_y明细（有fold）
    RMSE = RMSE,
    R2 = R2,
    cor = cor_pear,
    importance_raw = imp_df,
    importance_summary = imp_sum
  )
}


# 两阶段

    "  ~/Desktop/gbm_C_TOP30_fold_pred.txt\n",
    "  ~/Desktop/gbm_C_TOP30_oof_pred.txt\n")



# top 30 only

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(gbm)
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
})

nested_top30_gbm <- function(df, target_col="C",
                             K_outer=10, K_inner=5,
                             ntrees=3000, depth=3, shrink=0.01,
                             bag_frac=0.6, min_node=10,
                             top_n=30, seed=1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # numeric only + target
  num_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
  num_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  df <- df[, num_cols, drop=FALSE]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df), , drop=FALSE]
  
  outer_folds <- createFolds(df[[target_col]], k=K_outer, list=TRUE)
  
  pred_oof <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  selected_list <- vector("list", K_outer)
  
  for (fo in seq_along(outer_folds)) {
    test_idx  <- outer_folds[[fo]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), test_idx)
    
    train_df <- df[train_idx, , drop=FALSE]
    test_df  <- df[test_idx,  , drop=FALSE]
    
    #inner CV: select top30 only using TRAIN data
    inner_folds <- createFolds(train_df[[target_col]], k=K_inner, list=TRUE)
    imp_inner_list <- vector("list", K_inner)
    
    for (fi in seq_along(inner_folds)) {
      in_test  <- inner_folds[[fi]]
      in_train <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(train_df)), in_test)
      
      tr_in <- train_df[in_train, , drop=FALSE]
      
      m_in <- gbm(
        as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
        data = tr_in,
        distribution="gaussian",
        n.trees=ntrees,
        cv.folds=0,
        shrinkage=shrink,
        interaction.depth=depth,
        bag.fraction=bag_frac,
        n.minobsinnode=min_node,
        verbose=FALSE
      )
      
      imp_in <- summary(m_in, n.trees=ntrees, plotit=FALSE)
      imp_inner_list[[fi]] <- imp_in[1:min(top_n, nrow(imp_in)), c("var","rel.inf")]
    }
    
    imp_inner <- bind_rows(imp_inner_list) %>%
      group_by(var) %>%
      summarise(mean_rel_inf = mean(rel.inf), freq = n(), .groups="drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_rel_inf))
    
    top30_vars <- imp_inner %>% slice(1:top_n) %>% pull(var)
    selected_list[[fo]] <- data.frame(outer_fold=fo, var=top30_vars)
    
    # train final model on full outer-train using ONLY top30
    train30 <- train_df[, c(target_col, top30_vars), drop=FALSE]
    test30  <- test_df[,  c(target_col, top30_vars), drop=FALSE]
    
    m_out <- gbm(
      as.formula(paste(target_col, "~ .")),
      data = train30,
      distribution="gaussian",
      n.trees=ntrees,
      cv.folds=0,
      shrinkage=shrink,
      interaction.depth=depth,
      bag.fraction=bag_frac,
      n.minobsinnode=min_node,
      verbose=FALSE
    )
    
    pred_oof[test_idx] <- predict(m_out, newdata=test30, n.trees=ntrees, type="response")
    
    cat("Outer fold", fo, "done\n")
  }
  
  y <- df[[target_col]]
  resid <- y - pred_oof
  RMSE <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  R2   <- 1 - sum(resid^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  cor_pear <- cor.test(pred_oof, y, method="pearson")
  
  selected_df <- bind_rows(selected_list)
  
  list(
    pred = data.frame(y=y, pred=pred_oof),
    RMSE = RMSE,
    R2 = R2,
    cor = cor_pear,
    selected_top30_each_outer_fold = selected_df
  )
}

res_nested <- nested_top30_gbm(
  df = otu_group, target_col="C",
  K_outer=10, K_inner=5,
  ntrees=2000, depth=3, shrink=0.01,
  bag_frac=0.6, min_node=10,
  top_n=20, seed=1
)

# 通用指标计算函数
calc_metrics <- function(d, x, y) {
  x <- d[[x]]; y <- d[[y]]
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  
  resid <- y - x
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(resid^2))
  r2   <- 1 - sum((y - x)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)  # 注意：这里等价于用pred解释actual
  ct   <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method="pearson"))
  
  list(
    rmse = rmse,
    r2 = r2,
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p = ct$p.value
  )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 2.2e-16, "<2.2e-16",
         ifelse(p < 1e-3, sprintf("%.1e", p), sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

# 生成一个 Pred vs Actual 面板：点 + y=x + 拟合线 + 指标块 
pred_actual_panel <- function(d, xcol, ycol, xlab, ylab, tag=NULL) {
  
  m <- calc_metrics(d, xcol, ycol)
  
  # 指标文本（放右上角）
  lab <- paste0(
    "R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", m$r2), "\n",
    "RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", m$rmse), "\n",
    "\u03C1 = ", sprintf("%.3f", m$rho), "\n",
    "p = ", fmt_p(m$p)
  )
  
  # 计算坐标位置：右上角留白一点
  xr <- range(d[[xcol]], na.rm=TRUE)
  yr <- range(d[[ycol]], na.rm=TRUE)
  x_pos <- xr[1] + 0.98 * diff(xr)
  y_pos <- yr[1] + 0.98 * diff(yr)
  
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[xcol]], y = .data[[ycol]])) +
    # 点：两组
    geom_point(aes(shape = group, color = group),
               size = 2.2, alpha = 0.75, stroke = 0.6) +
    
    # 理想线：y = x
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1,
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey55") +
    
    # 拟合线：线性回归（校准）
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
                linewidth = 1.1, color = "black") +
    scale_color_manual(values = myPalette) +
    
 #   指标块
    # annotate("label",
    #          x = x_pos, y = y_pos,
    #          label = lab, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
    #          label.size = 0.2, size = 3.2,
    #          fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +

    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, tag = tag) +
    
    # 更省版面的主题
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(b = -6),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20)
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))
    )
}

assign_guild <- function(x, map) {
  for (nm in names(map)) {
    if (x %in% map[[nm]]) return(nm)
  }
  return("Unclassified")
}
```

## 3.1 KEGG pathway abundance and temporal trends

```{r kegg-temporal-trends}
# absolute abundance of KEGG
data <- read.delim("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/SD-SI-kegg.txt",
                     sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- read.delim("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/meta-data.txt",
                   sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)

head(data)

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 读入
data <- read.delim("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/SD-SI-kegg.txt",
                   sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- read.delim("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/meta-data.txt",
                       sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

# 颜色
cat_cols <- c(
  "Amino acid metabolism"                 = "#30426D",
  "Cellular processes"                    = "#DEA63B",
  "Central metabolism"                    = "#7CAE00",
  "Cofactors & Secondary metabolism"      = "#2e7d32",
  "Environmental information processing"  = "#DA3C34",
  "Genetic information processing"        = "#00A9FF",
  "Lipid & Glycan metabolism"             = "#807138",
  "Transport & Xenobiotics"               = "#1B8A73"
)

# 年份顺序
year_levels <- c("SD","11","12","14","15","17")

meta_cols <- c("type","pathway","name")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(data), meta_cols)

# 1) long table: pathway x sample
dat_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_cols), names_to = "seqid", values_to = "hits") %>%
  mutate(
    seqid = as.character(seqid),
    hits  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(hits))
  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% mutate(seqid = as.character(seqid)), by = "seqid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(DNA), !is.na(total_reads), !is.na(hits)) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(as.character(group), levels = year_levels),
    # CPM/RPM: counts per million reads
    cpm = (hits / total_reads) * 1e6,
    # DNA-weighted CPM (proxy)
    dna_w = cpm * DNA * 50,
    # 为了画图更稳：log10( +1 )，避免 0/极小值爆炸
    y = log10(dna_w)
  )

# 2) summary line per category (name)
sum_name <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(name, Year) %>%
  summarise(y_med = median(y, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3) plot
 ggplot(dat_long, aes(x = Year, y = y)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = pathway, color = name), alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(group = pathway, color = name), alpha = 0.50, size = 0.6) +
  geom_line(
    data = sum_name,
    aes(x = Year, y = y_med, group = name, color = name),
    linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = sum_name,
    aes(x = Year, y = y_med, color = name),
    size = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cat_cols, breaks = names(cat_cols), drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "log10( KEGG CPM × DNA)",
    color = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text()
  )  +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = 'black')) +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = 'black')) 

 
 ggsave("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/sd-si-kegg-abun.pdf",
         width = 5, height = 4)
```

## 3.2 SD vs SI (11–17) KEGG

```{r heatmap_bubble_plot}

## SD vs SI (11–17) KEGG heatmap
## GLM trend within SI + top pathways per class (scheme A)
## Order within each class: NotSig -> Decreasing -> Increasing, then |beta| desc
## Pathway label color = GLM trend

library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# 0) read

df <- read.delim("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/SD-SI-kegg.txt",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 check.names = FALSE,   # 关键
                 header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
metadata <- read.delim("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/meta-data.txt",
                   sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)


meta_cols <- c("pathway","type","name")

num_idx  <- which(!colnames(df) %in% meta_cols)
num_cols <- colnames(df)[num_idx]  # 包含重复 SD/11/...

new_cols <- paste0(num_cols, "__", seq_along(num_cols))
colnames(df)[num_idx] <- new_cols

col_map <- tibble(col = new_cols,
                  Year = sub("__.*$", "", new_cols))

to_num <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[\u00A0\u2007\u202F]", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)
  x <- gsub("^<", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^0-9eE\\.\\+\\-]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

year_levels <- c("SD","11","12","14","15","17")
si_years    <- c("11","12","14","15","17")

dat_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(new_cols), names_to = "col", values_to = "raw") %>%
  left_join(col_map, by = "col") %>%
  mutate(
    value = to_num(raw),
    Year  = factor(Year, levels = year_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  select(pathway, type, name, Year, value)


# 1) z-score (per pathway across ALL samples)

dat_long <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  mutate(
    mu  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sdv = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    z   = ifelse(is.na(sdv) | sdv == 0, NA_real_, (value - mu) / sdv)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) GLM within SI(11–17): beta + p + BH + adjR2

min_total_n <- 12
min_years   <- 3

glm_res <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Year %in% si_years) %>%
  mutate(Year_num = as.numeric(as.character(Year))) %>%
  group_by(name, pathway) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(Year_num))
    n_eff  <- nrow(d)
    n_year <- n_distinct(d$Year_num)
    if (n_eff < min_total_n || n_year < min_years) {
      return(tibble(n = n_eff, n_year = n_year, beta = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, adj_r2 = NA_real_))
    }
    fit <- lm(value ~ Year_num, data = d)
    sm  <- summary(fit)
    tibble(
      n = n_eff,
      n_year = n_year,
      beta = unname(coef(fit)[["Year_num"]]),
      p = sm$coefficients["Year_num","Pr(>|t|)"],
      adj_r2 = sm$adj.r.squared
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = ifelse(is.na(p), NA_real_, p.adjust(p, method = "BH")),
    trend = case_when(
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 & beta > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05 & beta < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE                                    ~ "NotSig"
    ),
    abs_beta = abs(replace_na(beta, 0))
  )


# 3) 每个大类(name)只保留 top4 (按 abs(beta))
#    同时：类内排序 NotSig -> Decreasing -> Increasing；各组内 abs(beta) desc

top_n <- 4
trend_rank <- c("NotSig" = 1, "Decreasing" = 3, "Increasing" = 2)

keep_tbl <- glm_res %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_beta), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%          # 每类 top4 abs(beta)
  ungroup()

# 重新做“最终显示顺序”
order_tbl <- keep_tbl %>%
  mutate(trend_rank = trend_rank[trend]) %>%
  arrange(name, trend_rank, desc(abs_beta), pathway)

path_levels <- order_tbl %>% pull(pathway)
name_levels <- order_tbl %>% pull(name) %>% unique()


# 4) Heatmap aggregation: median(z) per Year + Δ(17-SD)

min_n_per_group <- 3

agg <- dat_long %>%
  semi_join(keep_tbl %>% select(name, pathway), by = c("name","pathway")) %>%
  filter(Year %in% year_levels) %>%
  group_by(name, pathway, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_eff = sum(!is.na(z)),
    z_med = ifelse(n_eff >= min_n_per_group, median(z, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(Year, levels = year_levels))

agg_wide <- agg %>%
  select(name, pathway, Year, z_med) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = z_med)

agg_delta <- agg_wide %>%
  transmute(
    name, pathway,
    Year  = "Δ(17-SD)",
    z_med = `17` - SD
  )

heat_df <- bind_rows(
  agg,
  agg_delta %>% mutate(Year = factor(Year, levels = c(year_levels, "Δ(17-SD)")))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Year    = factor(as.character(Year), levels = c(year_levels, "Δ(17-SD)")),
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = path_levels),
    name    = factor(name, levels = name_levels)
  )


# 5) 星号：Wilcoxon SD vs 17（加在 Δ列）

min_wilcox_n_each <- 5

wilcox_res <- dat_long %>%
  semi_join(keep_tbl %>% select(name, pathway), by = c("name","pathway")) %>%
  filter(Year %in% c("SD","17")) %>%
  mutate(G2 = factor(Year, levels = c("SD","17"))) %>%
  group_by(name, pathway) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% filter(!is.na(value))
    n_sd <- sum(d$G2 == "SD")
    n_17 <- sum(d$G2 == "17")
    if (n_sd < min_wilcox_n_each || n_17 < min_wilcox_n_each) {
      return(tibble(p = NA_real_))
    }
    wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(value ~ G2, data = d, exact = FALSE))
    tibble(p = wt$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = ifelse(is.na(p), NA_real_, p.adjust(p, method = "BH")),
    star  = ifelse(!is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05, "*", "")
  )

star_df <- wilcox_res %>%
  filter(star == "*") %>%
  transmute(
    name,
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = path_levels),
    Year    = factor("Δ(17-SD)", levels = levels(heat_df$Year)),
    label   = star
  )


# 6) pathway 行名字颜色：按 GLM trend（沿用全文配色）

col_inc <- "#E3AF2E"
col_dec <- "#14A6B1"
col_ns  <- "#222222"

label_df <- keep_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    pathway = factor(pathway, levels = path_levels),
    lab_col = case_when(
      trend == "Increasing" ~ col_inc,
      trend == "Decreasing" ~ col_dec,
      TRUE                  ~ col_ns
    ),
    label = sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>%s</span>", lab_col, as.character(pathway))
  ) %>%
  arrange(pathway)

label_map <- setNames(label_df$label, as.character(label_df$pathway))


# 7) Plot A：Heatmap（不显示 strip，右侧单独 panel 放类名并左对齐）

fill_pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#80cbc4", "#F3F6EC", "#ffa000"))(100)

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = Year, y = pathway, fill = z_med)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(data = star_df, aes(x = Year, y = pathway, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2,  vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5,,color = "black") +
  facet_grid(name ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) label_map[x]) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = fill_pal,
    limits  = c(-3, 3),
    oob     = scales::squish,
    name    = "Median z-score"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),     # ✅ 主图不显示右侧类名
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
p_heat
# 右侧类名 panel（严格左对齐）
# 关键：用同样的 facet 顺序 (name_levels)，每个 facet 放一个 text，hjust=0
name_panel_df <- tibble(
  name = factor(name_levels, levels = name_levels),
  x = 1, y = 1, lab = as.character(name_levels)
)

p_name <- ggplot(name_panel_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab)) +
  geom_text(hjust = 0,  size = 4) +
  facet_grid(name ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 10), clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0)
  )

# 拼起来：左热图 + 右类名
final_plot <- p_heat + p_name + plot_layout(widths = c(8.6, 2))
final_plot

ggsave("~/Desktop/replot/plot-out/sd-si-kegg-glm-heat_top4.pdf",
       final_plot, width = 8, height = 6)
```

## 3.3 Functional maptree

```{r maptree}

library(utils)
library(devtools)
library(igraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(data.tree)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggtree)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggraph)

data_to_maptree = function(otu,tax,N){
## 依赖包

# 导入功能函数
vegan_otu <-  function(physeq){
  OTU <-  otu_table(physeq)
  if(taxa_are_rows(OTU)){
    OTU <-  t(OTU)
  }
  return(as(OTU,"matrix"))
}
vegan_tax <-  function(physeq){
  tax <-  tax_table(physeq)
  
  return(as(tax,"matrix"))
}
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(otu, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
               tax_table(tax)
)
#相对丰富转换
ps1_rela  = transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x) );ps1_rela 
# 提取otu表格
otu_table = as.data.frame(t(vegan_otu(ps1_rela)))
otu_table$mean = rowMeans(otu_table)
otu_table$ID = row.names(otu_table)
head(otu_table)
#按照从大到小排序
otu_table<- arrange(otu_table, desc(mean))
subtab = head(otu_table,N)
head(subtab)
row.names(subtab) =subtab$ID
subtab = subtab[,1:(dim(subtab)[2]-2)]
subtab = as.matrix(subtab)

#对phyloseq取子集
ps_sub <- phyloseq(otu_table(subtab, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), 
                   tax_table(tax))
ps_sub
# 整理tax文件
#注意本次制作的是OTU水平的maptree, 将species level 标记为了OTU or ASV
tax = as.data.frame(vegan_tax(ps_sub))
#添加水平识别标示
tax$upkingdom = paste("U_",tax$upkingdom,sep = "--")
tax$Kingdom = paste(tax$upkingdom,"D_",tax$Kingdom,sep = "--")
tax$Phylum = paste(tax$Kingdom,"P_",tax$Phylum,sep = "--")
tax$Class = paste(tax$Phylum,"C_",tax$Class,sep = "--")
tax$classlow = paste(tax$Class,"O_",tax$classlow,sep = "--")
tax$OTU = paste("ASV",row.names(tax),sep = "--")
# # 对不同分类水平的tax未知物种进行区分
tax_table(ps_sub) = as.matrix(tax)
head(tax)

# 构造边文件
#提取分组信息
Desep_group <- as.character(colnames(tax))
#按照form--to格式来排布数据
edge_t = tax[c(Desep_group[1:2])]
dim(edge_t)
edge_t <-  dplyr::distinct(edge_t)
dim(edge_t)
for (i in 2:5) {
  result = tax[c(Desep_group[i:(i+1)])]
  colnames(result) = colnames(edge_t)
  result <-  dplyr::distinct(result)
  edge_t = rbind(edge_t,result)
}
dim(edge_t)
colnames(edge_t) = c("from","to")
if (length(unique(tax$Kingdom)) >1) {
  edge_t$from = as.character(edge_t$from)
  edge_t$to = as.character(edge_t$to)
  buc = data.frame(from = c("king_up","king_up"),to =c("D_Archaea","D_Bacteria") )
  row.names(buc) = c("sp_K","sp_k1")
  deg = rbind(edge_t,buc)
}

maptree_add2_plot = function(x,fillcolor ){
  #解析输入
  ps_sub = mapdata[[4]]
  vertices_t = mapdata[[3]]
  deg = mapdata[[2]]
  # ps_sub = ps_sub
  #vertices_t = vertices_t
  #deg = deg
  fillcolor="levels"
  # 防止合并后名称改变
  fillcolor = paste("addtab",fillcolor,sep = "_")
  colnames(addtab) = paste("addtab",colnames(addtab),sep = "_")
  vegan_otu <-  function(physeq){
    OTU <-  otu_table(physeq)
    if(taxa_are_rows(OTU)){
      OTU <-  t(OTU)
    }
    return(as(OTU,"matrix"))
  }
  vegan_tax <-  function(physeq){
    tax <-  tax_table(physeq)
    
    return(as(tax,"matrix"))
  }
  
  tax_table = as.data.frame(vegan_tax(ps_sub))
  otu_table = as.data.frame(t(vegan_otu(ps_sub)))
  #计算全部均值
  otu_table$mean = rowMeans(otu_table)
  #组合结果
  inde = merge(otu_table,tax_table,by = "row.names", all = TRUE)
  head(inde)
  row.names(inde) = inde$Row.names
  inde$Row.names = NULL
  
  dim(inde)
  inde = merge(inde,addtab,by = "row.names",all.x = TRUE)
  row.names(inde) = inde$Row.names
  inde$Row.names = NULL
  dim(inde)
  #更改颜色列统一为fill_color
  colnames(inde) <- gsub("addtab_level","fill_color",colnames(inde))
  #添加高级注释信息进入函数
  row.names(inde) = paste("ASV",row.names(inde),sep = "--")
  ##将全部信息合并到节点属性中
  data_plot = merge(vertices_t,inde,by = "row.names",all = TRUE)
  row.names(data_plot) = data_plot$Row.names
  data_plot$Row.names = NULL
  head(data_plot)
  #指定大小映射列将NA值做转换为0
  asa =data_plot$mean
  data_plot$mean[is.na(asa)] = 0
  #选择是否平方根标准化丰度
  # data_plot$mean[!is.na(asa)] = sqrt(data_plot$mean[!is.na(asa)])
  
  mygraph <- graph_from_data_frame( deg, vertices= data_plot )
  # 设置颜色映射参数
  data = create_layout(mygraph, layout = 'circlepack',weight = mean, sort.by = NULL, direction = "out")
  colnames(data)
  i = "fill_color" 
  data[[i]] = as.character(data[[i]])
  data[[i]][is.na(data[[i]])] = "NOTA"
  unique(data[[i]])
  data[[i]] = factor(data[[i]],levels =unique(data[[i]]) )
  levels(data[[i]])
  data[i] = data[[i]]
  colbar <-length(unique(data[[i]]))
  mi = brewer.pal(9,"Set1")
  # mi = c( "#E41A1C", "#377EB8" ,"#4DAF4A",'#FFFFFF')
  fil_colors = mi[1:colbar ]
  #fil_colors = c( "#E41A1C", "#377EB8" ,"#4DAF4A",'#FFFFFF')
 names(fil_colors ) = unique(data$fill_color)
 fil_colors
 # fil_colors[1]= NA
  p = ggraph(mygraph, layout = 'circlepack',weight = mean, sort.by = NULL,direction = "out") +
    geom_node_circle(aes(fill = factor(fill_color),color = as.factor(depth)) ,size =0.5) +
 #  scale_fill_manual(values= fil_colors ) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("0" = alpha("#beaed4",1), 
                                "1" = alpha("#e0e0e0",0.7), 
                                "2" = alpha("#e0e0e0",1),
                                "3" = alpha("#e0e0e0",1),
                                "4"=alpha("#e0e0e0", 0.8),
                                "5"=alpha("white",0.0)) )+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c('#d50000','#00b8d4','#ff6d00','#d50000','#00b8d4','#ff6d00',
                                 '#d50000','#00b8d4','#ff6d00','#d50000','#00b8d4','#ff6d00')) +
   # scale_color_manual(values=c("0" = "#1f78b4", "1" =NA, "2" = NA, "3" = NA, "4"=NA, 
    #                           "5"= NA)) +
    # scale_color_manual(values=c("0" = "#1f78b4", "1" = "#e31a1c", "2" = "#e0e0e0", 
    #     "3" = "#e0e0e0", "4"="#e0e0e0", "5"="#e0e0e0", "6"="#33a02c", "7"="#b2df8a", "8"="#984ea3", "9"="white") ) +
    #geom_node_text( aes(label=new_label), size=4,repel = TRUE) +
    geom_node_text( aes(label=new_label), size=3,repel = TRUE) +
    theme_void() +
    theme( legend.position="none",plot.margin = unit(rep(0,4), "cm")) +
    coord_fixed()
  #p
 #  p + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
   
   
  return(list(p,deg,data_plot,mygraph,fil_colors))
}
```

```{r dbRDA_cycling}
library(vegan)

library(tidyverse)

func <-  read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/ecology/model_env/pathway.txt',

env <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/ecology/model_env/eco_stat_cgf.txt',

                  sep = "\t")
func <- func[,-c(1)]

View(func_hel)
View(env)

func_hel <- decostand(func, method = 'hellinger')

rda.data = func_hel
env <- env[,-c(37:41)]


mod0.db = capscale(rda.data ~ 1, dist = "bray", data = env) #using add = TRUE option will give different results, more variables
mod1.db = capscale(rda.data ~., dist = "bray", data = env)
step.res.db.all = ordiR2step(mod0.db, mod1.db, perm.max = 1000, pin = 0.05) #about 35.5% explained  
all.select.db = env[, attributes(step.res.db.all$terms)$term.labels]
all.select.db 

#GLM
library(MuMIn)
library(hier.part)
library(relaimpo)
library(ggtern)
library(ggalt)

relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(nrow=ncol(all.select.db)))

#  relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(ncol=1))
# relaimp.df = data.frame(matrix(nrow=1))

relaimp.rsq = c()
relaimp.adjrsq = c()
relaimp.p = c()
relaimp.var.y = c()

for (name in colnames(func_hel)){
  print(name)
  lm.fit = lm(func_hel[,name]~., data=all.select.db)
  lm.rela = calc.relimp(lm.fit, type = c("lmg"), rela = TRUE) #this function actually has a groups option to combine variables into groups
  relaimp.df = cbind(relaimp.df, lm.rela@lmg)
  relaimp.var.y = c(relaimp.var.y, lm.rela@var.y)
  lm.summary = summary(lm.fit)
  relaimp.rsq = c(relaimp.rsq, lm.summary$r.squared)
  relaimp.adjrsq = c(relaimp.adjrsq, lm.summary$adj.r.squared)
  relaimp.p = c(relaimp.p, pf(lm.summary$fstatistic[1], lm.summary$fstatistic[2], lm.summary$fstatistic[3], lower.tail=F))
}

relaimp.df.final = rbind(relaimp.df.final, padjust = p.adjust(relaimp.df.final["p",], method="fdr"))
```

## 3.5 Mediation analysis

```{r mediation_analysis}
 library(dplyr)
 library(stringr)

 df_meta <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/mediation/metadata.txt',
                   row.names = 1, sep = '\t',header = T,stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
 
 df_g <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/meta/mpa_profile_genus.txt',
                   row.names = 1, sep = '\t',header = T,stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

 ## 1) 只选 SI 样本
 meta_si <- df_meta %>%
   as.data.frame() %>%
   tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID") %>%
   mutate(SeqID = as.character(SeqID)) %>%
   filter(type == "SI")
 
 ## 2) 从 df_g 列名提取 SeqID（下划线前数字），并只保留 SI 的列
 # df_g 的列名类似： "109_FKDL210119808-1a"
 col_seqid <- str_extract(colnames(df_g), "^[0-9]+")
 names(col_seqid) <- colnames(df_g)
 
 si_seqid <- meta_si$SeqID
 keep_cols <- names(col_seqid)[col_seqid %in% si_seqid]
 
 # 子集：只保留 SI 样本列
 g_si <- df_g[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
 
 # 重命名列：用 SeqID 作为列名，便于后面对齐
 colnames(g_si) <- col_seqid[keep_cols]
 
 ## 3) 对齐样本顺序（按 meta_si 顺序），并丢弃缺失样本
 common_ids <- intersect(meta_si$SeqID, colnames(g_si))
 meta_si <- meta_si %>% filter(SeqID %in% common_ids)
 g_si <- g_si[, meta_si$SeqID, drop = FALSE]   # 按 meta 顺序排列列
 
 ## 4) 只保留 Bacteria / Archaea / Fungi（从 clade 的 d__xxx 判断）
 # df_g 的行名是 clade
 clade <- rownames(g_si)
 domain <- str_match(clade, "^d__([^|]+)")[,2]
 
 keep_domain <- domain %in% c("Bacteria", "Archaea", "Fungi")
 g_si <- g_si[keep_domain, , drop = FALSE]
 clade <- rownames(g_si)
 
 ## 5) 从 clade 抽取 genus（g__），并聚合到 genus 层级
 genus <- str_match(clade, "\\|g__([^|]+)")[,2]
 genus[is.na(genus) | genus == "" | genus == "unclassified" | genus == "Unclassified"] <- "Unclassified"
 
 # 可选：去掉 Unclassified（推荐，想保留）
 keep_genus <- genus != "Unclassified"
 g_si2 <- g_si[keep_genus, , drop = FALSE]
 genus2 <- genus[keep_genus]
 
 # 聚合：同一 genus 多行求和
 g_genus_counts <- rowsum(as.matrix(g_si2), group = genus2, reorder = FALSE)
 g_genus_counts <- as.data.frame(g_genus_counts, check.names = FALSE)
 
 ## 6) prevalence 过滤：在 >=10% 样本中 count>0
 n <- ncol(g_genus_counts)
 prev <- rowSums(g_genus_counts > 0) / n
 g_genus_filt <- g_genus_counts[prev >= 0.10, , drop = FALSE]
 
 ## 7) （可选）再加一个 abundance 过滤：总 counts 很低的 genus 去掉
 # 例如：总counts >= 10（按数据量可调）
# g_genus_filt <- g_genus_filt[rowSums(g_genus_filt) >= 10, , drop = FALSE]
 
 ## 8) 输出两个版本：counts / relative abundance
 g_genus_ra <- sweep(g_genus_filt, 2, colSums(g_genus_filt), FUN = "/")
 
 ## 9) （可选）CLR 变换：后续做线性/中介更稳
 # 伪计数建议用 0.5 或 1（看稀疏程度）
 pseudocount <- 0.5
 X <- as.matrix(g_genus_filt) + pseudocount
 X_ra <- sweep(X, 2, colSums(X), "/")
 clr <- function(mat) {
   logm <- log(mat)
   gm <- colMeans(logm)
   sweep(logm, 2, gm, "-")
 }
 g_genus_clr <- as.data.frame(clr(X_ra), check.names = FALSE)
 
 ## 10) 最终：meta_si + 微生物矩阵（转置成 sample x genus 更方便建模）
 micro_counts <- as.data.frame(t(g_genus_filt), check.names = FALSE)  # samples x genus
 micro_ra     <- as.data.frame(t(g_genus_ra),   check.names = FALSE)
 micro_clr    <- as.data.frame(t(g_genus_clr),  check.names = FALSE)
 
 # 把 SeqID 加回去
 micro_counts <- micro_counts %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID")
 micro_ra     <- micro_ra     %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID")
 micro_clr    <- micro_clr    %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("SeqID")
 
 # 合并 metadata（建模用）
 dat_counts <- meta_si %>% left_join(micro_counts, by = "SeqID")
 dat_ra     <- meta_si %>% left_join(micro_ra,     by = "SeqID")
 dat_clr    <- meta_si %>% left_join(micro_clr,    by = "SeqID")
 
 ## 11) 保存（可选）
 # write.table(g_genus_filt, "SI_genus_counts_filt.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE)
 # write.table(dat_clr,      "SI_meta_plus_genus_CLR.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
 
 # 过滤不随着时间变化的
 
 library(dplyr)
 library(tidyr)
 library(purrr)
 library(broom)
 
 meta_cols  <- c("SeqID","Year","type")
 genus_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dat_clr), meta_cols)
 
 df <- dat_clr %>% mutate(YearF = factor(Year))
 
 long <- df %>%
   select(all_of(meta_cols), YearF, all_of(genus_cols)) %>%
   pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genus_cols),
                names_to = "genus", values_to = "clr")
 
 res_aov <- long %>%
   group_by(genus) %>%
   summarise(
     p = {
       fit <- lm(clr ~ YearF)
       aov_tab <- anova(fit)               # base R
       aov_tab["YearF", "Pr(>F)"]          # 整体检验 YearF
     },
     R2 = {
       fit <- lm(clr ~ YearF)
       summary(fit)$r.squared
     },
     .groups = "drop"
   ) %>%
   mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
   arrange(FDR)
 
 # 过滤（根据数据量，阈值可调）
 sig_time <- res_aov %>% filter(FDR < 0.1, R2 >= 0.05)
 nrow(sig_time)
 
 dat_clr_time <- dat_clr %>%
   select(all_of(meta_cols), all_of(sig_time$genus))
 
 ncol(dat_clr_time) # 924 genus
 
 
 # 代谢物
 df_m <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/metabo_re/2_28/meta_in_all.txt',
                    row.names = 1, sep = '\t',header = T,stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
 
 
 library(dplyr)
 library(tidyr)
 library(stringr)
 
 
 ## 1) 准备 genus 样本信息：只保留 SeqID + Year（来自 dat_clr_time 或 dat_clr）
 # dat_clr_time: 筛过时间变化 genus 后的表（含 SeqID/Year/type + genus列）
 meta_g <- dat_clr_time %>%
   select(SeqID, Year, type) %>%
   mutate(SeqID = as.character(SeqID))
 
 ## 2) 准备 metabolite 表：确保有 SeqID/year 列
 m0 <- df_m %>% as.data.frame()
 
 # 如果 SeqID 在行名（你读入时 row.names=1），先变成列
 m0 <- m0 %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("FID")
 
 # 找到 SeqID 列名
 stopifnot("SeqID" %in% colnames(m0))
 m0 <- m0 %>%
   mutate(SeqID = as.character(SeqID))
 
 # 包含各文件，year 列名可能是 year 或 Year的情况
 year_col <- if ("year" %in% colnames(m0)) "year" else if ("Year" %in% colnames(m0)) "Year" else NA
 stopifnot(!is.na(year_col))
 
 ## 3) 只保留 genus 表里存在的 SeqID，并对齐顺序
 common_ids <- intersect(meta_g$SeqID, m0$SeqID)
 
 meta_g2 <- meta_g %>% filter(SeqID %in% common_ids) %>% arrange(SeqID)
 m1 <- m0 %>% filter(SeqID %in% common_ids) %>% arrange(SeqID)
 
 # 对齐检查
 stopifnot(all(meta_g2$SeqID == m1$SeqID))
 
 ## 4) 只保留分析需要的列：SeqID + year + metabolite features
 meta_cols_m <- c("FID", "SeqID", year_col)
 feat_cols <- setdiff(colnames(m1), meta_cols_m)

# 可选：确保数值型
storage.mode(X) <- "double"

fit_one_met <- function(j, M, X, YearF, met_name, genus_names) {
  y <- M[, j]
  ok <- is.finite(y)
  y <- y[ok]
  Yr <- YearF[ok]
  Xo <- X[ok, , drop=FALSE]
  
  # 预先构建 Year 的设计矩阵（不含截距）
  Z <- model.matrix(~ Yr)  # 含截距
  # 对每个 genus 单独拟合：y ~ x + Yr
  # 返回 beta_x, p_x, partial_R2（可选）
  
  out <- lapply(seq_along(genus_names), function(i) {
    x <- Xo[, i]
    if (all(!is.finite(x))) return(NULL)
    
    df <- data.frame(y=y, x=x, Yr=Yr)
    fit <- lm(y ~ x + Yr, data=df)
    sm <- summary(fit)
    ct <- coef(sm)
    if (!("x" %in% rownames(ct))) return(NULL)
    
    # p for x
    p <- ct["x","Pr(>|t|)"]
    beta <- ct["x","Estimate"]
    
    # partial R2 for x: (SSE_reduced - SSE_full) / SSE_reduced
    fit0 <- lm(y ~ Yr, data=df)
    sse0 <- sum(resid(fit0)^2)
    sse1 <- sum(resid(fit)^2)
    pR2 <- if (sse0 > 0) (sse0 - sse1) / sse0 else NA_real_
    
    data.frame(
      metabolite = met_name,
      genus = genus_names[i],
      beta = beta,
      p = p,
      partial_R2 = pR2,
      n = length(y)
    )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# 预先把 Y 对 YearF 残差化（一次就够）
y_r <- resid(lm(dat[[Y_name]] ~ dat$YearF))

med_perm_one <- function(x, m, dat, y_r, P = 500) {
  # 残差化 X 和 M（控制 YearF）
  x_r <- resid(lm(dat[[x]] ~ dat$YearF))
  m_r <- resid(lm(dat[[m]] ~ dat$YearF))
  
  # a 路径
  fit_a <- lm(m_r ~ x_r)
  a <- coef(fit_a)[2]
  
  # b 路径（控制 x_r）
  fit_b <- lm(y_r ~ x_r + m_r)
  b <- coef(fit_b)["m_r"]
  
  T_obs <- a * b
  
  # 置换：打乱 x_r（Freedman–Lane 风格残差置换）
  # 保持 m_r 与 y_r 不变，破坏 x->m 与 x->y 的关联
  T_perm <- numeric(P)
  n <- length(x_r)
  
  for (i in seq_len(P)) {
    xp <- x_r[sample.int(n, n, replace = FALSE)]
    ap <- coef(lm(m_r ~ xp))[2]
    bp <- coef(lm(y_r ~ xp + m_r))["m_r"]
    T_perm[i] <- ap * bp
  }
  
  p <- (1 + sum(abs(T_perm) >= abs(T_obs), na.rm = TRUE)) / (P + 1)
  
  data.frame(
    x = x, m = m,
    a = a, b = b,
    indirect = T_obs,
    p_ind = p
  )
}

# 5) 单条边：Freedman–Lane 残差置换检验 
med_perm_one <- function(x, m, dat, y_r, P = 1000) {
  x_r <- resid(lm(dat[[x]] ~ dat$YearF))
  m_r <- resid(lm(dat[[m]] ~ dat$YearF))
  
  a <- coef(lm(m_r ~ x_r))[2]
  b <- coef(lm(y_r ~ x_r + m_r))["m_r"]
  T_obs <- a * b
  
  n <- length(x_r)
  T_perm <- numeric(P)
  
  for (i in seq_len(P)) {
    xp <- x_r[sample.int(n, n, replace = FALSE)]
    ap <- coef(lm(m_r ~ xp))[2]
    bp <- coef(lm(y_r ~ xp + m_r))["m_r"]
    T_perm[i] <- ap * bp
  }
  
  p <- (1 + sum(abs(T_perm) >= abs(T_obs), na.rm = TRUE)) / (P + 1)
  
  data.frame(
    y = Y_name,
    x = x, m = m,
    a = a, b = b,
    indirect = T_obs,
    p_ind = p
  )
}

# fix empty/duplicate colnames
bad <- which(is.na(names(df)) | names(df) == "")
if (length(bad) > 0) names(df)[bad] <- paste0("XEMPTY_", seq_along(bad))
names(df) <- make.unique(names(df))

#  0b) keep only selected endpoints 
keep_y <- c("D50","Ks","C","N","EC","K","Ca","Mg","Fe","Ti","Zn","Ni","Co","Cr","Cd","Ba")
df <- df %>% filter(y %in% keep_y)

# 1) keep Top N edges per endpoint 
N <- 30
df_small <- df %>%
  group_by(y) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(indirect), n = N, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

#  2) collapse low-frequency phylum (<10) to "Other phyla" 
phy_cnt <- df_small %>% count(x_phylum, name = "n_phy")
low_phy <- phy_cnt %>% filter(n_phy < 10) %>% pull(x_phylum)

#  2b) collapse low-frequency superclass (<10) to "Other superclasses" 
super_cnt <- df_small %>% count(m_superclass, name = "n_super")
low_super <- super_cnt %>% filter(n_super < 10) %>% pull(m_superclass)

df2 <- df_small %>%
  mutate(
    Domain     = x_domain,
    Phylum     = ifelse(x_phylum %in% low_phy, "Other phyla", x_phylum),
    Superclass = ifelse(m_superclass %in% low_super, "Other superclasses", m_superclass),
    Endpoint   = y,
    w_raw      = abs(indirect)
  )

plot_dat <- df2 %>%
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Superclass, Endpoint) %>%
  summarise(w = sum(w_raw, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
```

# 5. Cultivated-isolate screening and field representation

## 5.1 Isolate taxonomy

```{r isolated_taxonomy}
  library(ape)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggtreeExtra)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(dplyr)
  

  # 1. 读树和注释

  tr <- read.tree('~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/consensus_v2.nwk')
  
  dat1 <- read.delim(
    '~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/consensus_v2_idlabel.txt',
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  table(dat1$genus)
  dat1 <- dat1 %>% filter(ID %in% tr$tip.label)
  
  # 每个tip给一个固定长度的bar
  dat1$abun <- 0.1
  

  # 2. genus分组

  genus_counts <- table(dat1$genus)
  rare_genus <- names(genus_counts[genus_counts < 10])
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- ifelse(dat1$genus %in% rare_genus, "Other genus", dat1$genus)
  
  group_levels <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Pseudarthrobacter",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  dat1$genus_grouped <- factor(dat1$genus_grouped, levels = group_levels)
  

  # 3. 因子顺序

  dat1$medium <- factor(dat1$medium, levels = c("AIA", "MA", "R2A", "TSA", "Nutrient agar"))
  dat1$Temperature <- factor(dat1$Temperature, levels = c("15", "30", "45"))
  dat1$Concentration <- factor(dat1$Concentration, levels = c("0.01", "0.1", "1"))
  dat1$genus <- factor(dat1$genus, levels = c("Arthrobacter","Pseudarthrobacter","Microbacterium","Sinorhizobium","Streptomyces","Other genus"))
  
  genus_order <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Pseudarthrobacter",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  
  dat1$Selected_ring <- ifelse(dat1$Selected == "No", "Not selected", "Selected")
  dat1$Selected_ring <- factor(dat1$Selected_ring, levels = c("Not selected", "Selected"))
  
 
  # 4. 给树分组

  group_list <- split(dat1$ID, dat1$genus_grouped)
  tr2 <- groupOTU(tr, group_list)
  tr2 <- ladderize(tr2)
  
  
  # 5. 配色
  
  genus_cols <- c(
    "Arthrobacter"      = "#D81B60",
    "Pseudarthrobacter" = "#3366CC",
    "Microbacterium"    = "#1B9E77",
    "Sinorhizobium"     = "#E67E22",
    "Streptomyces"      = "#8E44AD",
    "Other genus"            = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  
  medium_cols <- c(
    "AIA" = "#E64B35",
    "MA"  = "#4DBBD5",
    "R2A" = "#00A087",
    "TSA" = "#3C5488",
    "Nutrient agar"  = "#b39ddb"
  )
  
  temp_cols <- c(
    "15" = "#FDD9A0",
    "30" = "#F39C12",
    "45" = "#D94801"
  )
  
  conc_cols <- c(
    "0.01" = "#C7E9C0",
    "0.1"  = "#74C476",
    "1"    = "#238B45"
  )
  
  selected_cols <- c(
    "Not selected" = "#D9D9D9",
    "Selected"     = "#111111"
  )
  
  # 6. 主树

  p <- ggtree(
    tr2,
    layout = "circular",
    size = 0.22,
    aes(color = group)
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = genus_cols,
      breaks = genus_order,
      limits = genus_order,
      name = "Genus"
    ) +
    geom_treescale(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      fontsize = 5,
      offset = 0.5,
      linesize = 0.8
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  
  p1 <- p +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = medium),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.085,
      offset = 0.020,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.02
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = medium_cols,
      breaks = c("AIA", "MA", "R2A", "TSA", "Nutrient agar"),
      limits = c("AIA", "MA", "R2A", "TSA", "Nutrient agar"),
      name = "Medium"
    )
  p1

  # 9. ring 2: temperature

  p2 <- p1 +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = Temperature),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.085,
      offset = 0.010,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.02
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = temp_cols,
      breaks = c("15", "30", "45"),
      limits = c("15", "30", "45"),
      name = "Temperature"
    )
  p2

  # 10. ring 3: concentration

  p3 <- p2 +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = Concentration),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.085,
      offset = 0.010,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.02
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = conc_cols,
      breaks = c("0.01", "0.1", "1"),
      limits = c("0.01", "0.1", "1"),
      name = "Concentration"
    )
  p3
 
  # 11. ring 4: selected for coculture

  p4 <- p3 +
    new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = Selected_ring),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.055,
      offset = 0.010,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.015
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = selected_cols,
      breaks = c("Selected", "Not selected"),
      limits = c("Selected", "Not selected"),
      name = "Co-culture screen"
    )
  
  p4
  
  
  ggsave(filename = '~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/cdhit_16s.tree-update.pdf',width = 10, height = 10)
  
  #堆叠图展示genus ratio
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  
  # 固定顺序
  dat1$genus_grouped <- factor(
    dat1$genus_grouped,
    levels = c(
      "Arthrobacter",
      "Pseudarthrobacter",
      "Microbacterium",
      "Sinorhizobium",
      "Streptomyces",
      "Other genus"
    )
  )
  
  # 统计 count 和 ratio
  genus_ratio <- dat1 %>%
    count(genus_grouped, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(ratio = n / sum(n))
  
  genus_ratio
  
  # 配色
  genus_cols <- c(
    "Arthrobacter"      = "#D81B60",
    "Pseudarthrobacter" = "#3366CC",
    "Microbacterium"    = "#1B9E77",
    "Sinorhizobium"     = "#E67E22",
    "Streptomyces"      = "#8E44AD",
    "Other genus"            = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  
  # 100% stacked barplot

  ## Sand-incubation-panel
  library(ape)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggtreeExtra)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(dplyr)
  
  
  # 1. read data
 
  dat2 <- read.delim(
    "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/metagenome/50-culture/50.cas.txt",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  tr <- read.tree("~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/metagenome/50-culture/16s-50.culture.nwk")
  
  dat1 <- read.delim(
    "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/metagenome/50-culture/16s-culture_idlabel.txt",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  dat1 <- dat1 %>% filter(ID %in% tr$tip.label)
  
 
  # 2. genus grouping
  # 规则：
  # - 前面大树已有主genus：保留并沿用原色
  # - 新genus中，出现 >= 3 次：保留并赋新色
  # - 其余并入 Other genus

  major_genus <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Pseudarthrobacter",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces"
  )
  
  genus_counts <- table(dat1$genus)
  
  new_keep_genus <- names(genus_counts)[
    genus_counts >= 3 & !(names(genus_counts) %in% major_genus)
  ]
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- ifelse(
    dat1$genus %in% c(major_genus, new_keep_genus),
    dat1$genus,
    "Other genus"
  )
  

  # 3. color palette
  # 旧颜色保持一致；新增genus给新颜色

  base_cols <- c(
    "Arthrobacter"      = "#D81B60",
    "Pseudarthrobacter" = "#3366CC",
    "Microbacterium"    = "#1B9E77",
    "Sinorhizobium"     = "#E67E22",
    "Streptomyces"      = "#8E44AD"
  )
  
  # 给新出现且 >=3 次的 genus 分配新颜色
  # 可按需要扩充
  extra_pool <- c(
    "#7CAE00",  # olive green
    "#F564E3",  # pink-purple
    "#00BFC4",  # teal
    "#A6761D",  # brown
    "#E7298A",  # magenta
    "#66A61E"   # green
  )
  
  if (length(new_keep_genus) > length(extra_pool)) {
    stop("新增 genus 太多，extra_pool 颜色不够，请补充颜色。")
  }
  
  extra_cols <- setNames(extra_pool[seq_along(new_keep_genus)], new_keep_genus)
  
  genus_cols <- c(
    base_cols,
    extra_cols,
    "Other genus" = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  
  # legend 顺序：
  # 先前面已有的5个
  # 再新增保留的 genus（按字母排序或按频次都可以）
  # 最后 Other genus
  new_keep_genus <- sort(new_keep_genus)
  
  
  genus_order <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Bacillus_A",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Peribacillus",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- factor(dat1$genus_grouped, levels = genus_order)
  
  
  # 4. significant factor
  
  dat1$significant <- factor(dat1$significant, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  
  sig_cols <- c(
    "No"  = "#D9D9D9",
    "Yes" = "#1B9E77"
  )
  

  # 5. group tree
  
  dat2 <- split(dat1$ID, dat1$genus_grouped)
  tr2  <- groupOTU(tr, dat2)
  
 
  # 6. base tree

  p_base <- ggtree(
    tr2,
    layout = "circular",
    aes(color = group),
    size = 0.58
  ) + geom_treescale(x = 0, y = 0, width = 0.5, fontsize = 6)
  p_base 
  
 
  # 7. labels
 
  p2 <- p_base +
    geom_tiplab2(
      aes(label = label),
      size = 4.8,
      offset = 0.08,
      align = TRUE,
      linetype = "dotted",
      linesize = 0.6,
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = genus_cols,
      breaks = genus_order,
      limits = genus_order,
      name = "Genus",
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.4))
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.16, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
    )
  p2

  # 8. outer significant ring
  # significant 仍放最外围
 
  p3 <- p2 +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_fruit(
      data = dat1,
      geom = geom_bar,
      mapping = aes(y = ID, x = abun, fill = significant),
      stat = "identity",
      orientation = "y",
      pwidth = 0.035,
      offset = 0.28,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.015
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_cols,
      breaks = c("No", "Yes"),
      limits = c("No", "Yes"),
      name = "Priority strains"
    )
  
  p3
  
  ggsave(filename = '~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/50.tree-update.pdf',width = 8, height = 8)
```

```{r isolate-mag}
# see the genus seperately
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)


# File paths

iso_file <- "~/Desktop/replot/culture/isolate_MAGs_field/isolates_genus_count.tsv"
mag_file <- "~/Desktop/replot/culture/isolate_MAGs_field/fieldMAGs_genus_count.tsv"

# Common settings

top_n <- 10
bar_fill <- "#4C78A8"

make_top_plot <- function(df, total_denominator = NULL, ylab_text = "Percentage", remove_unclassified = FALSE) {
  
  if (remove_unclassified) {
    df <- df %>% filter(genus != "Unclassified")
  }
  
  if (is.null(total_denominator)) {
    total_denominator <- sum(df$n)
  }
  
  df2 <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number(),
           genus_plot = if_else(rank <= top_n, genus, "Others")) %>%
    group_by(genus_plot) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(percent = n / total_denominator * 100) %>%
    arrange(desc(percent))
  
  # Others放最下面
  df2 <- df2 %>%
    mutate(genus_plot = if_else(genus_plot == "Others", "zzz_Others", genus_plot)) %>%
    mutate(genus_plot = fct_reorder(genus_plot, percent)) %>%
    mutate(genus_plot = fct_recode(genus_plot, Others = "zzz_Others"))
  
  p <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = genus_plot, y = percent)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = bar_fill) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)), hjust = -0.12, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab_text) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
    )
  
  return(p)
}


# Panel B: isolates

iso_df <- read_tsv(
  iso_file,

)
```

## 5.3 Sterile-sand isolate screening

```{r isolate-screening}

  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
  
  mydata <- read.delim(
    '~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/50-strains/ks.all.plot.txt',
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
  )
  
  mydata$ks <- as.numeric(mydata$ks)
  
  # 只保留 MA / R2A
  mydata <- mydata %>%
    filter(medium %in% c("MA", "R2A"))
  
  # 每个 medium 对应 NC
  nc_map <- c("MA" = "MA-NC", "R2A" = "R2A-NC")
  
  # genus 合并逻辑（和原来一致）
  mydata <- mydata %>%
    mutate(
      genus_plot = case_when(
        genus %in% c("Bacillus_A", "Bacillus_I", "Bacillus") ~ "Bacillus_A",
        genus %in% c("Arthrobacter", "Microbacterium", "Peribacillus",
                     "Streptomyces") ~ genus,
        TRUE ~ "Other genus"
      ),
      genus_plot = factor(
        genus_plot,
        levels = c("Arthrobacter", "Bacillus_A", "Microbacterium",
                   "Peribacillus", "Streptomyces", "Other genus")
      )
    )
  
  # 调色板
  genus_cols <- c(
    Arthrobacter   = "#e41a1c",
    Bacillus_A     = "#377eb8",
    Microbacterium = "#4daf4a",
    Peribacillus   = "#ff7f00",
    Streptomyces   = "#984ea3",
    'Other genus'         = "#999999"
  )
  
  # 逐株 vs 对应 NC 统计
  stat_res <- mydata %>%
    distinct(group, medium, genus_plot) %>%
    filter(!group %in% c("MA-NC", "R2A-NC")) %>%
    mutate(nc_group = nc_map[medium]) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      n_group = sum(mydata$group == group & mydata$medium == medium, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nc    = sum(mydata$group == nc_group & mydata$medium == medium, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_group = median(mydata$ks[mydata$group == group & mydata$medium == medium], na.rm = TRUE),
      median_nc    = median(mydata$ks[mydata$group == nc_group & mydata$medium == medium], na.rm = TRUE),
      delta_ks     = median_group - median_nc,
      pct_change   = (median_group - median_nc) / median_nc * 100,
      p_value      = wilcox.test(
        x = mydata$ks[mydata$group == group & mydata$medium == medium],
        y = mydata$ks[mydata$group == nc_group & mydata$medium == medium],
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      priority_strain = ifelse(delta_ks < 0 & p_value < 0.1, "Priority", "Other")
    ) %>%
    arrange(medium, delta_ks)
  
  stat_res
  
  # x轴顺序：按各组中位数升序，NC放最后
  order_df <- mydata %>%
    group_by(group, medium) %>%
    summarise(med_ks = median(ks, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(is_nc = group %in% c("MA-NC", "R2A-NC")) %>%
    arrange(medium, is_nc, med_ks)
  
  group_levels <- order_df$group
  
  mydata <- mydata %>%
    mutate(
      group  = factor(group, levels = unique(group_levels)),
      medium = factor(medium, levels = c("MA", "R2A"))
    )
  
  # 给 priority 组准备带星号的标签
  label_df <- stat_res %>%
    mutate(
      group_label = ifelse(priority_strain == "Priority",
                           paste0(group, "*"),
                           group)
    ) %>%
    select(group, medium, group_label)
  
  # 用于替换 x 轴标签
  label_map <- setNames(label_df$group_label, label_df$group)
  
  # NC 自己也保留原名
  label_map["MA-NC"] <- "MA-NC"
  label_map["R2A-NC"] <- "R2A-NC"
  
  # 需要打星号的组
  star_df <- stat_res %>%
    filter(priority_strain == "Priority") %>%
    select(group, medium)
  
  # 给每个组计算星号放置高度：该组最大值 + 一点偏移
  star_pos <- mydata %>%
    group_by(group, medium) %>%
    summarise(
      y = max(ks, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.06,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(star_df, by = c("group", "medium")) %>%
    mutate(label = "*")
  
  star_pos
  
  
  
  p_box2 <- ggplot(mydata, aes(x = group, y = ks, colour = genus_plot)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.62,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.65
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85,
      width = 0.045, height = 0
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = star_pos,
      aes(x = group, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      size = 7,
      vjust = 0
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ medium, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_cols, name = "Genus") +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      # strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      # axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Estimated Ks (m/day)"
    )
  
  p_box2
  
  ggsave(filename = "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/50-strains/50-ks.boxplot-update.pdf", width = 10,height = 6)
  
  plot_df <- stat_res %>%
    mutate(
      group = fct_reorder(group, pct_change),
      priority_strain = factor(priority_strain, levels = c("Other", "Priority"))
    )
  
  p_effect <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = pct_change, colour = genus_plot)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = priority_strain), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ medium, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_cols, name = "Genus") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Other" = 16, "Priority" = 17), name = "Screening result") +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      # strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      # axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "% change in estimated Ks vs medium control"
    )
  
  p_effect

  ggsave(filename = "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/50-strains/50-ks.boxplot-effect.pdf", width = 10,height = 6)
  
    
  p_delta <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = delta_ks, colour = genus_plot)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = priority_strain), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ medium, nrow = 2, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_cols, name = "Genus") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Other" = 16, "Priority" = 17), name = "Screening result") +
    theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(Delta*" estimated Ks (m/day) vs medium control")
    )
  
  p_delta
```
