## 6.1 F8 incubation experiment

### Hydraulic conductivity

```{r f8-lab-ks}
# an example for visualization and ststistics with mixed model
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)

  data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/data-plot/5_10_deof_tar.txt',
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                     header = T, sep = "\t")
  data$day <- as.factor(data$day)
  
  # 修改组名
  
  data$group <- dplyr::recode(data$group,
                              "1*" = "1x inoculum",
                              "2*" = "2x inoculum")
  
  
  # 固定顺序
  data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("NC", "1x inoculum", "2x inoculum"))
  

  
  #F8
  mycolors <- c(
    "NC" = "#E64B35FF",
    "1x inoculum" = "#e0f7fa",
    "2x inoculum" = "#00bcd4"
  )
  
  # H12
  mycolors <- c("NC" = "#E64B35FF",
                "1x inoculum" = "#CE99D6",
                "2x inoculum" = "#8565BF")
  
  # myborder <- c(
  #   "NC" = "#E64B35FF",
  #   "1x inoculum" = "#263238",
  #   "2x inoculum" = "#263238"
  # )
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = day, y = Ks, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(color = group),
      width = 0.6,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      color = "#263238",
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.65),
      size = 1.6,
      alpha = 0.7,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = myborder) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Estimated Ks (m/day)", fill = "Group", color = "Group") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
     # text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "black")
    )
  
  
  data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/data-plot/5_10_deof_tar.txt',
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                     header = T, sep = "\t")
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "1*", "2*")),
      day   = factor(day, levels = c(0, 21, 42, 63, 120)),
      order = factor(order),
      rep_id = interaction(group, order, drop = TRUE)
    )
  
  # mixed model
  fit_lmm <- lmer(Con ~ group * day + (1 | rep_id), data = data)
  
  anova(fit_lmm)
  summary(fit_lmm)
  
  
  emm1 <- emmeans(fit_lmm, ~ group | day)
  pairs(emm1, adjust = "BH")
  
  plot(fit_lmm)
  qqnorm(resid(fit_lmm))
  qqline(resid(fit_lmm))
  
  shapiro.test(resid(fit_lmm))
  
  
  
```

### Particle-volume distribution

```{r f8-lab-particle-volume}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
df <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/No9-volume.txt',
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                 header = T, sep = "\t")
df <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/ct-volume-nc-3.txt',
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                 header = T, sep = "\t")
table(df$group)
df$group <- factor(df$group,levels = c('No3','NC'))



# 清洗 & 转换体积
df <- df %>%
  filter(Volume > 0) %>%
  mutate(log_volume = log10(Volume))


# 设置统一 bin
bin_breaks <- seq(floor(min(df$log_volume)), ceiling(max(df$log_volume)), length.out = 50)
bin_mid <- head(bin_breaks, -1) + diff(bin_breaks) / 2

# 体积加权统计
df_stat <- df %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(log_volume, breaks = bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(group, bin) %>%
  summarise(volume_sum = sum(Volume), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_weighted = volume_sum / sum(volume_sum) * 100,
    cum_weighted = cumsum(freq_weighted),
    mid = bin_mid[as.numeric(bin)]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 计算 50% 累计位置（视觉标线位置）

median_pos <- df_stat %>%
  arrange(group, mid) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_log_volume = approx(
      x = cum_weighted,
      y = mid,
      xout = 50
    )$y
  )
median_pos

# 主图绘制


ggplot(df_stat, aes(x = mid)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = freq_weighted), fill = "#E0B83E", width = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum_weighted), color = "#4DADB9", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = median_pos, aes(xintercept = median_log_volume), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Frequency",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "Cumulative Volume %")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression(log[10](Volume~nm^3)),  # 改为“立方纳米”单位
    limits = c(14.5, 17.5),
    breaks = seq(14.5, 17.5, by = 0.5)  # 自定义坐标轴刻度，网格更整齐
  ) +
  theme_pubr(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, colour = 'black'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, colour = 'black'),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCF9F0"),
    
    # 加虚线网格线样式（重点）
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed"),
   # panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 可选：隐藏小网格
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )





ggsave(filename = '~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/ct-nc-3.pdf',width = 6, height = 5)



# 显著性检验：取 log10(Volume) 样本，KS检验 + Mann-Whitney U 检验
# ---------------------------------
x1 <- df$log_volume[df$group == "No3"]
x2 <- df$log_volume[df$group == "NC"]

# KS test, 比较两个累计分布曲线,非参数、分布无假设，非常适合
ks_result <- ks.test(x1, x2)
print(ks_result) #  p-value < 2.2e-16

# Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Mann-Whitney), 比较中位数或秩和
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(x1, x2)
print(wilcox_result) # p-value < 2.2e-16


```

### Bacterial colonization and viability

```{r f8-lab-colonization}
# PMA-qPCR visualization
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggplot2)

# load data 
data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/PMA/lab-dose-c.txt',
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                   header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

# 
# PMA-qPCR: data cleaning -> technical replicates -> viability plots
# Goal:
#   - Panel A: target viability = live-target / total-target
#   - Panel B: 16S viability   = live-16s / total-16s
# Notes:
#   - site (A01/A02/A03, E01/E02/E03, F01/F02/F03) are TECHNICAL replicates.
#   - Collapse to biological replicates by sample_id = first letter (A/E/F).
#   - Data in input file are copies per reaction; convert to copies/mg sand:
#       0.1 g sand, 50 uL elution, 2 uL template -> factor = 0.25
#   - LOD (lowest standard) = 1e2 copies/reaction -> LOD_mg = 25 copies/mg
#   - For target in NC (not assayed; NA), we show as ND via LOD fill for plotting only.
# 



# 1) Parameters

infile <- "~/Desktop/replot/culture/PMA/lab-dose-c.txt" #f8
infile <- "~/Desktop/replot/culture/PMA/lab-dose-3.txt" #h12

CF <- 0.25             # copies/reaction -> copies/mg sand (2 uL template)
LOD_rxn <- 1e2         # lowest standard (copies/reaction)
LOD_mg  <- LOD_rxn*CF  # 25 copies/mg (for plotting ND as LOD)

# color palette 
cols <- c(
  "NC"    = "#E64B35FF",  # orange-red
  "wt-5"  = "#E2F7FA",  # light blue
  "wt-10" = "#2ABED2"   # deeper blue
)

#E2F7FA

cols <- c(
  "NC"    = "#E64B35FF",  # orange-red
  "wt-5"  = "#ce93d8",  # light blue
  "wt-10" = "#7e57c2"   # deeper blue
)



# 2) Read data

raw <- read.delim(
  infile,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

# 3) Clean + convert units

df <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    day = as.numeric(day),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10")),
    site = as.character(site),
    # biological replicate ID (A/E/F) from site column
    sample_id = sub("^([A-Za-z]).*$", "\\1", site),
    
    # parse numbers (protect against "NA" strings) and convert to copies/mg
    `total-16s`     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`total-16s`))     * CF,
    `live-16s`      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`live-16s`))      * CF,
    `total-target`  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`total-target`))  * CF,
    `live-target`   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`live-target`))   * CF
  )


# 4) Collapse TECHNICAL replicates (A01/A02/A03 -> A; etc.)
#    Keep mean per biological replicate (A/E/F) for each day x group

df_sum <- df %>%
  group_by(day, group, sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_16s = mean(`total-16s`, na.rm = TRUE),
    live_16s  = mean(`live-16s`,  na.rm = TRUE),
    total_t   = mean(`total-target`, na.rm = TRUE),
    live_t    = mean(`live-target`,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# 5) Viability metrics

df_sum <- df_sum %>%
  mutate(
    viab_16s = ifelse(!is.na(total_16s) & total_16s > 0, live_16s / total_16s, NA_real_),
    viab_t   = ifelse(!is.na(total_t)   & total_t   > 0, live_t   / total_t,   NA_real_)
  )

# 6) Build plotting data
#    Only day 63 & 120 for points/boxplots, day 0 can be used as background in other plots if needed.
#    For target in NC (NA), fill with LOD for plotting as ND (optional but useful for showing "no detection").

viab_long <- df_sum %>%
  filter(day %in% c(63, 120)) %>%
  transmute(
    day = factor(day),
    group,
    sample_id,
    viab_target = viab_t,
    viab_16s    = viab_16s
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(viab_target, viab_16s),
    names_to = "assay",
    values_to = "viability"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    assay = recode(
      assay,
      viab_target = "Inoculated strain",
      viab_16s    = "Total bacteria"
    )
  )


# 7) Plot: Viability over time (two panels)
#    x = day, boxplot + points, group colors as specified


# Viability plot 

viab_long2 <- viab_long %>%
  mutate(
    viability = ifelse(assay == "Inoculated strain (target)" & group == "NC" & is.na(viability),
                       0, viability)
  )

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)

ggplot(viab_long2, aes(x = day, y = viability, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = interaction(day, group)),
    position = dodge,
    width = 0.50,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.60,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    aes(group = interaction(day, group), fill = group),
    dodge.width = 0.75,
    width = 0.05,
    varwidth = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.3,
    size = 2.6,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ assay, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cols,
    breaks = c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10"),
    labels = c("NC", "1× inoculum", "2× inoculum")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day",
    y = "Viability ratio (PMA+ / no PMA)",
    title = "PMA-qPCR viability over time",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

  # pairs(emm_g_in_day, adjust = "bonferroni")  # 更保守
  
  # 2) Time effect within each group: day120 vs day63 for wt-5 and wt-10
  emm_day_in_g <- emmeans(m, ~ day | group)
  pairs(emm_day_in_g, adjust = "none")
  
  # 3) 如果想要回到“倍数差异（fold-change）”的可解释输出：
  # log10尺度的差 -> 10^(差) = fold-change
  contrast(emm_g_in_day, method = "revpairwise") %>%
    summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(fold = 10^estimate)   # wt-10 / wt-5 的fold（在每个day）
```

### Sand-surface alteration

```{r f8-lab-surface-alteration}
data <- read.delim(
  "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/cq-eds-20260430/120-lab-sem.txt",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

# Clean data
# F8 labeled as WT, H12 labeled as WT-3
df <- data %>%
  mutate(
    group = trimws(group),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "WT", "WT-3"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group))


# Colors

mycolors <- c(
  "NC"   = "#E64B35FF",
  "WT"   = "#5EBEAE",
  "WT-3" = "#A890D1"
)


# Theme

theme_my <- theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "black", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "black")
  )


# Helper function

make_boxplot <- function(dat, yvar, title, ylab,
                         y_add_lower = 0,
                         y_add_upper = NULL,
                         hide_x_text = FALSE) {
  
  yvals <- dat[[yvar]]
  
  if (is.null(y_add_upper)) {
    y_add_upper <- diff(range(yvals, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.01
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = group, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      color = "#263238",
      width = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.85,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = group),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.10, height = 0),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.2,
      stroke = 0.35,
      color = "#263238",
      alpha = 0.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0), add = c(y_add_lower, y_add_upper))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = ylab,
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_my
  
  if (hide_x_text) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5,
        vjust = 0.5,
        color = "black",
        size = 18
      )
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}


# Subsets

df_nc_wt <- df %>%

# NC vs WT: Mean local variance

p1 <- make_boxplot(
  dat = df_nc_wt,
  yvar = "Mean_local_variance",

library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)

data <- read.delim(
  "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/cq-eds-20260430/120-lab-sem.txt",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

df <- data %>%
  mutate(
    group = trimws(group),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "WT", "WT-3"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group))

# Wilcoxon test function

run_wilcox <- function(dat, yvar, comparison_name) {
  dat %>%
    wilcox_test(
      formula = as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ group")),
      exact = FALSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric = yvar,
      comparison_set = comparison_name
    ) %>%
    select(comparison_set, metric, group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p)
}


# NC vs WT

df_nc_wt <- df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("NC", "WT")) %>%
  droplevels()

test_nc_wt_variance <- run_wilcox(
  df_nc_wt,
  yvar = "Mean_local_variance",
  comparison_name = "NC vs WT"
)

test_nc_wt_fraction <- run_wilcox(
  df_nc_wt,
  yvar = "Altered_surface_fraction",
  comparison_name = "NC vs WT"
)


# NC vs WT-3

df_nc_wt3 <- df %>%
  filter(group %in% c("NC", "WT-3")) %>%
  droplevels()

test_nc_wt3_variance <- run_wilcox(
  df_nc_wt3,
  yvar = "Mean_local_variance",
  comparison_name = "NC vs WT-3"
)

test_nc_wt3_fraction <- run_wilcox(
  df_nc_wt3,
  yvar = "Altered_surface_fraction",
  comparison_name = "NC vs WT-3"
)


# Combine results

wilcox_results <- bind_rows(
  test_nc_wt_variance,
  test_nc_wt_fraction,
  test_nc_wt3_variance,
  test_nc_wt3_fraction
) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_label = recode(
      metric,
      "Mean_local_variance" = "Mean local variance",
      "Altered_surface_fraction" = "Altered surface fraction"
    ),
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    signif = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    comparison_set,
    metric,
    metric_label,
    group1,
    group2,
    n1,
    n2,
    statistic,
    p,
    p_adj,
    signif
  )

wilcox_results
```

```{r lab-ph-ec-dynamics}
  library(ggplot2)

  mydata <- read.delim(
    '~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/es-ph-wt-5-10.txt',

  # group 顺序
  mydata$group <- factor(
    mydata$group,
    levels = c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10", "wt3-5", "wt3-10")
  )
  
  # 真实 day 数值
  mydata$day_num <- as.numeric(as.character(mydata$day))
 
  
  # 横坐标等距位置
  day_levels <- sort(unique(mydata$day_num))
  mydata$day_id <- match(mydata$day_num, day_levels)
  
  # 两套数据
  data_1 <- mydata %>%
    filter(group %in% c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10")) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10")))
  
  data_2 <- mydata %>%
    filter(group %in% c("NC", "wt3-5", "wt3-10")) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "wt3-5", "wt3-10")))
  
  # 颜色
  mycolors_1 <- c(
    "NC"    = "#E64B35FF",
    "wt-5"  = "#e0f7fa",
    "wt-10" = "#00bcd4"
  )
  
  mycolors_2 <- c(
    "NC"     = "#E64B35FF",
    "wt3-5"  = "#CE99D6",
    "wt3-10" = "#8565BF"
  )
  
  plot_box_jitter_glm_equalx <- function(data, yvar, ylab_text, fill_colors) {
    
    dodge_w <- 0.55
    
    # 用真实 day 拟合 glm，再映射回等距 day_id 上画线
    pred_df <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(levels(data$group), function(g) {
        sub <- data %>% filter(group == g)
        
        fit <- glm(
          formula = as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ day_num")),
          data = sub
        )
        
        newdat <- data.frame(day_num = sort(unique(sub$day_num)))
        newdat$pred  <- predict(fit, newdata = newdat, type = "response")
        newdat$group <- g
        newdat$day_id <- match(newdat$day_num, sort(unique(data$day_num)))
        newdat
      })
    )
    
    ggplot(data, aes(x = day_id, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = group)) +
      
      geom_boxplot(
        aes(group = interaction(day_id, group)),
        position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
        width = 0.5,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        alpha = 0.9,
        color = "#263238",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      
      geom_jitter(
        aes(color = group),
        position = position_jitterdodge(
          jitter.width = 0.04,
          dodge.width = dodge_w
        ),
        size = 2.0,
        alpha = 0.7,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      
      geom_smooth(
        data = pred_df,
        aes(x = day_id, y = pred, color = group, group = group),
        method = "lm",
        se = FALSE,
        alpha = 0.75,
        linewidth = 1.0,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
      scale_color_manual(values = fill_colors) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = seq_along(day_levels),
        labels = day_levels
      ) +
      labs(x = "", y = ylab_text) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black")
      )
  }
  
  # 4张图
  p1 <- plot_box_jitter_glm_equalx(data_1, "Es", "Es", mycolors_1)
  p2 <- plot_box_jitter_glm_equalx(data_1, "pH", "pH", mycolors_1)
  p3 <- plot_box_jitter_glm_equalx(data_2, "Es", "Es", mycolors_2)
  p4 <- plot_box_jitter_glm_equalx(data_2, "pH", "pH", mycolors_2)
  

  
  (p1 | p3 | p2 | p4) 
  
  ggsave(filename = "~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/ks_es-all.pdf", width = 12,height = 3)

  
  
  library(dplyr)
  
  mydata <- read.delim(
    '~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/es-ph-wt-5-10.txt',
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # group 顺序
  mydata$group <- factor(
    mydata$group,
    levels = c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10", "wt3-5", "wt3-10")
  )
  
  # day 转真实数值
  mydata$day_num <- as.numeric(as.character(mydata$day))
  # 如果 day 不是纯数字，比如 d21/d42/d63/d120，用下面这句替代上一句：
  # mydata$day_num <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", as.character(mydata$day)))
  
  # 两套数据
  data_1 <- mydata %>%
    filter(group %in% c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10")) %>%
    mutate(
      panel = "wt",
      group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "wt-5", "wt-10"))
    )
  
  data_2 <- mydata %>%
    filter(group %in% c("NC", "wt3-5", "wt3-10")) %>%
    mutate(
      panel = "wt3",
      group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "wt3-5", "wt3-10"))
    )
  
  all_data <- bind_rows(data_1, data_2)
  
  # 单个模型提取统计量的函数
  get_lm_stats <- function(df, response_var) {
    fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(response_var, "~ day_num")), data = df)
    sm <- summary(fit)
    
    data.frame(
      slope     = unname(coef(fit)["day_num"]),
      p_value   = sm$coefficients["day_num", "Pr(>|t|)"],
      r_squared = sm$r.squared
    )
  }
  
  # 计算 Es 和 pH 各组统计结果
  res_es <- all_data %>%
    group_by(panel, group) %>%
    group_modify(~ get_lm_stats(.x, "Es")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(variable = "Es")
  
  res_ph <- all_data %>%
    group_by(panel, group) %>%
    group_modify(~ get_lm_stats(.x, "pH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(variable = "pH")
  
  # 合并成一张表
  res_table <- bind_rows(res_es, res_ph) %>%
    select(variable, panel, group, slope, p_value, r_squared) %>%
    mutate(
      slope     = round(slope, 4),
      p_value   = signif(p_value, 3),
      r_squared = round(r_squared, 4)
    ) %>%
    arrange(variable, panel, group)
  
  print(res_table)
```

# 7. F8 metabolism and siderophore mechanism

## 7.1 F8 metabolomic analysis

```{r f8-metabolomics}


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(limma)
  library(pheatmap)
})

data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/isolation_culture_metabolite/meta_uniq/meta_uniq.txt',
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                   header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

meta_anno <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/isolation_culture_metabolite/meta_uniq/metabolite-metadate.txt',
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                        header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(Label_low = tolower(Label),
         Group = case_when(
           Label_low == "qc" ~ "QC",
           Label_low == "nc" ~ "NC",
           Label_low == "wt" ~ "WT",
           TRUE ~ "OTHER"
         )) %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("QC","NC","WT"))

feat_cols <- setdiff(colnames(data), c("meta","Label","Label_low","Group"))
feat_cols <- feat_cols[str_detect(feat_cols, "^(NEG|POS)\\d+")]
X <- data %>% select(all_of(feat_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
mode(X) <- "numeric"
X[X == 0] <- NA

is_qc <- data$Group == "QC"
is_nc <- data$Group == "NC"
is_wt <- data$Group == "WT"

#  pre-filter by missingness in QC
qc_miss <- colMeans(is.na(X[is_qc, , drop = FALSE]))
keep1 <- qc_miss <= 0.50
X <- X[, keep1, drop = FALSE]

#  impute missing: half-min per feature
half_min_impute <- function(v){
  if (all(is.na(v))) return(v)
  mn <- min(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  v[is.na(v)] <- mn / 2
  v
}
X_imp <- apply(X, 2, half_min_impute)

#  QC reference vector: feature-wise median in QC
qc_ref <- apply(X_imp[is_qc, , drop = FALSE], 2, median)

#  PQN scaling factor per sample: median of ratios to QC reference
# (avoid division by 0)
qc_ref2 <- ifelse(qc_ref <= 0, NA_real_, qc_ref)

ratio_mat <- sweep(X_imp, 2, qc_ref2, "/")
# scaling factor = median ratio across features
sf <- apply(ratio_mat, 1, function(r) median(r, na.rm = TRUE))

# normalize
X_norm <- sweep(X_imp, 1, sf, "/")

#  log2 transform
logX <- log2(X_norm + 1)

# QC RSD filter after normalization (use CV on original scale OR SD on log scale)
qc_sd <- apply(logX[is_qc, , drop = FALSE], 2, sd)
qc_mean <- colMeans(logX[is_qc, , drop = FALSE])
qc_rsd <- qc_sd / abs(qc_mean + 1e-8)

keep2 <- qc_rsd <= 0.30
logX <- logX[, keep2, drop = FALSE]
message("Features kept after QC filters: ", ncol(logX))

# differential analysis: limma WT vs NC 

keep_samples <- data$Group %in% c("NC", "WT")
grp <- factor(data$Group[keep_samples], levels = c("NC", "WT"))

# logX: samples x features（前面 QC-PQN 后得到的 log2 矩阵）
# limma 需要：features x samples
expr <- t(logX[keep_samples, , drop = FALSE])
expr <- as.matrix(expr)

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + grp)
colnames(design) <- levels(grp)
design <- as.matrix(design)

fit <- lmFit(expr, design)  # 注意：不要写 fit$coefficients 之类

cont <- makeContrasts(WTvsNC = WT - NC, levels = design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

tt <- topTable(fit2, coef = "WTvsNC", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")


library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

tt_fix <- tt %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%   # 把 POS9093 之类变成 Feature 列
  rename(
    log2FC = logFC,
    pvalue = P.Value,
    padj   = adj.P.Val
  )

ann <- meta_anno %>%
  transmute(
    Feature = Label,
    Superclass = ifelse(is.na(Superclass) | Superclass == "" | Superclass == "NA",
                        "Unclassified", Superclass)
  ) %>%
  distinct()


tt2 <- tt_fix %>%
  left_join(ann, by = "Feature") %>%
  mutate(
    Superclass = ifelse(is.na(Superclass), "Unclassified", Superclass),
    direction = ifelse(log2FC > 0, "Enriched in WT", "Enriched in NC")
  )


write.table(tt2,
            file = "~/Desktop/replot/culture/isolation_culture_metabolite/meta_uniq/wt_vs_nc_limma_QCPQN.tsv",
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

sig <- tt2 %>% filter(padj < 0.05, abs(log2FC) >= 1)
message("Significant metabolites: ", nrow(sig))

#  heatmap 
if (nrow(sig) >= 2) {
  feat_sig <- sig$Feature
  mat <- t(logX[keep_samples, feat_sig, drop = FALSE])  # features x samples
  colnames(mat) <- data$meta[keep_samples]
  
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  mat_z[is.na(mat_z)] <- 0
  
  col_anno <- data.frame(Group = grp)
  rownames(col_anno) <- colnames(mat_z)
  
  row_anno <- sig %>%
    select(Feature, Superclass, direction) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Feature")
  
  ord <- rownames(row_anno)[order(row_anno$Superclass, row_anno$direction)]
  mat_z <- mat_z[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  row_anno <- row_anno[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  
  pheatmap(mat_z,
           annotation_col = col_anno,
           annotation_row = row_anno,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           fontsize_row = 6,
           border_color = NA,
           clustering_method = "ward.D2",
           main = "WT vs NC | QC-PQN normalized | limma (FDR<0.05, |log2FC|>=1)")
} else {
  message("Too few significant features for a heatmap under current thresholds.")
}


acid_superclass <- c(
  "Organic acids and derivatives",
  "Carboxylic acids and derivatives",
  "Hydroxy acids and derivatives",
  "Keto acids and derivatives"
)

sig_wt_acid <- sig %>%
  filter(direction == "Enriched in WT") %>%
  filter(Superclass %in% acid_superclass)

message("WT-enriched acid-related metabolites: ", nrow(sig_wt_acid))




ann_colors <- list(
  Group = c(
    "NC" = "#E64B35",  
    "WT" = "#3C5488"   
  ),
  Superclass = c(
    "Carboxylic acids and derivatives" = "#E69F00",  
    "Hydroxy acids and derivatives"    = "#56B4E9",  
    "Keto acids and derivatives"       = "#CC79A7",  
    "Organic acids and derivatives"    = "#009E73"   
  )
)


if (nrow(sig_wt_acid) >= 2) {
  feat_sig <- sig_wt_acid$Feature
  
  mat <- t(logX[keep_samples, feat_sig, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(mat) <- data$meta[keep_samples]
  
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat))); mat_z[is.na(mat_z)] <- 0
  
  col_anno <- data.frame(Group = grp)
  rownames(col_anno) <- colnames(mat_z)
  
  row_anno <- sig_wt_acid %>%
    select(Feature, Superclass) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Feature")
  
  ord <- rownames(row_anno)[order(row_anno$Superclass)]
  mat_z <- mat_z[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  row_anno <- row_anno[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  
  pheatmap(
    mat_z,
    annotation_col = col_anno,
    annotation_row = row_anno,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    border_color = NA,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    treeheight_col = 0,   # 关掉顶部树状图
    treeheight_row = 0,   # 关掉左侧树状图
    main = "WT vs NC | WT-enriched acid-related metabolites | QC-PQN + limma",
     filename = "~/Desktop/replot/culture/isolation_culture_metabolite/meta_uniq/wt_vs_nc_wt_enriched_acid_heatmap.pdf",
     width = 12, height = 8
  )
}

library(dplyr)
```

```{r bibc-genetic-validation}
df <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/data-plot/culture-4-DFOE.txt',
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                 header = T, sep = "\t")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    type  = str_trim(as.character(type)),
    group = str_trim(as.character(group)),
    value = as.numeric(value)
  ) %>%
  # 把各种“非标准横线”统一成 "-"
  mutate(group = str_replace_all(group, "[\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2014\u2212]", "-")) %>%
  # 统一 type 名字
  mutate(type = recode(type,
                       "no added Fe" = "no added Fe",
                       "5 uM Fe"     = "5 uM Fe",
                       "5uM Fe"      = "5 uM Fe")) %>%
  # 如果你文件里原来是 _purT，就替换成 ΔpurT；如果已经是 ΔpurT 不会受影响
  mutate(group = recode(group, "_purT" = "ΔpurT"))

# 检查一下是不是四组都在（很重要）
print(unique(df$group))
print(unique(df$type))

# baseline: WT under no added Fe 
baseline <- df %>%
  filter(type == "no added Fe", group == "WT") %>%
  summarise(base = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(base)

stopifnot(!is.na(baseline), baseline > 0)

# two-way ANOVA + post-hoc
 
 library(dplyr)
 library(stringr)
 library(emmeans)
 
 #  Two-way ANOVA（含交互）
 fit <- lm(value_rel ~ group * type, data = df2)
 anova_tab <- anova(fit)
 anova_tab
 
 # （可选）检查残差正态性/方差齐性，n=3 仅作参考
 # par(mfrow=c(1,2)); plot(fit, which=1); plot(fit, which=2); par(mfrow=c(1,1))
 
 # Post-hoc A：每个Fe条件内，菌株之间比较 
 emm_group_within_type <- emmeans(fit, ~ group | type)
 emm_group_within_type 
 
 # 常用：Tukey（同一type内所有组两两比较）
 pairs_group_Tukey <- pairs(emm_group_within_type, adjust = "tukey")
 pairs_group_Tukey
 
 # 或者想更“宽松/通用”：BH (FDR)
 pairs_group_BH <- pairs(emm_group_within_type, adjust = "BH")
 pairs_group_BH
 
 # Post-hoc B：每个菌株内，加铁 vs 不加铁 
 emm_type_within_group <- emmeans(fit, ~ type | group)
 
 pairs_type_BH <- pairs(emm_type_within_group, adjust = "BH")
 pairs_type_BH

 
 # 所有的一起看事后比较
 
 library(emmeans)
 library(dplyr)
 
 # fit <- lm(value_rel ~ group * type, data = df2)
 
 # 1) 得到 8 个 cell mean：group:type
 emm_all <- emmeans(fit, ~ group * type)
 
 # 2) 全部两两比较（8 组 -> 28 个对比）
 # 选一个校正方法：
 # - "tukey"：最经典的全对全（强烈推荐）
 # - "BH"：FDR，也可以
 all_pairs_tukey <- pairs(emm_all, adjust = "tukey")
 all_pairs_bh    <- pairs(emm_all, adjust = "BH")
 
 # 打印（看全部）
 all_pairs_tukey
 # all_pairs_bh
 
 # 3) 只看显著的（比如 Tukey 校正后 p < 0.05）
 sig_tukey <- as.data.frame(all_pairs_tukey) %>%
   filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
   arrange(p.value)
 
 sig_tukey
 
 # 4) 导出全表 + 显著表（写补充材料最方便）
 write.csv(as.data.frame(all_pairs_tukey), "posthoc_allpairs_groupXtype_Tukey.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 write.csv(sig_tukey, "posthoc_allpairs_groupXtype_Tukey_sigOnly.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 
 # 5)（可选）把 8 组做字母分组（compact letter display）
 # install.packages("multcompView")  # 若没装
 cld_all <- cld(emm_all, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters)
 cld_all
 write.csv(as.data.frame(cld_all), "CLD_groupXtype_Tukey.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 7.5 Environmental tolerance and siderophore production

```{r f8-environmental-response}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)


## 通用函数：整理数据 + mixed model + 作图

run_growth_plot <- function(file_path,
                            cond_levels,
                            cond_name,
                            cond_label,
                            color_map,
                            out_pdf,
                            y_max = 2.4) {
  
  ## 1. read data
  mydata <- read.delim(
    file_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  ## 2. long format
  dat_long <- mydata %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cond_levels),
      names_to = cond_name,
      values_to = "OD600"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      !!cond_name := factor(.data[[cond_name]], levels = cond_levels),
      id = factor(id),
      hour = as.numeric(hour)
    )
  
  ## 3. summary for plotting
  dat_sum <- dat_long %>%
    group_by(hour, .data[[cond_name]]) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_OD = mean(OD600, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_OD = sd(OD600, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  ## 4. mixed model
  ## hour 作为 factor 更稳，不强加线性假设
  form <- as.formula(paste0("OD600 ~ factor(hour) * ", cond_name, " + (1|id)"))
  fit <- lmer(form, data = dat_long)
  
  anova_tab <- anova(fit)
  print(anova_tab)
  
  ## 提取 p 值
  p_time <- anova_tab["factor(hour)", "Pr(>F)"]
  p_cond <- anova_tab[cond_name, "Pr(>F)"]
  p_int  <- anova_tab[paste0("factor(hour):", cond_name), "Pr(>F)"]
  
  fmt_p <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) return("NA")
    if (p < 0.001) return("< 0.001")
    sprintf("= %.3f", p)
  }
  
  stat_lab <- paste0(
    "Mixed model\n",
    "Time P ", fmt_p(p_time), "\n",
    cond_label, " P ", fmt_p(p_cond), "\n",
    "Interaction P ", fmt_p(p_int)
  )
  
  ## 5. 作图
  y_top <- max(dat_sum$mean_OD + dat_sum$sd_OD, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.01
  
  p <- ggplot(dat_sum, aes(x = hour, y = mean_OD, color = .data[[cond_name]], group = .data[[cond_name]])) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_OD - sd_OD, ymax = mean_OD + sd_OD),
      width = 0.45,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    # annotate(
    #   "label",
    #   x = min(dat_sum$hour) + 0.05 * diff(range(dat_sum$hour)),
    #   y = y_max * 0.98,
    #   label = stat_lab,
    #   hjust = 0,
    #   vjust = 1,
    #   size = 4.1,
    #   label.size = 0.3,
    #   fill = "white"
    # ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(dat_sum$hour))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_top)) +
    labs(
      x = "Time (h)",
      y = expression(OD[600]),
      color = cond_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 6.3, height = 4.8)
  
  ## 6. 导出统计表
  out_stat <- data.frame(
    term = c("Time", cond_label, "Interaction"),
    p_value = c(p_time, p_cond, p_int)
  )
  
  stat_file <- sub("\\.pdf$", "_mixed_model_stats.csv", out_pdf)
  write.csv(out_stat, stat_file, row.names = FALSE)
  
  invisible(list(
    raw = mydata,
    long = dat_long,
    sum = dat_sum,
    fit = fit,
    anova = anova_tab,
    plot = p
  ))
}

plot_cas_box <- function(dat, yvar, ylab, outfile) {
  y_top <- max(dat[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.02
  
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = type, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = fill_key)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.62,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.75,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.10,
      size = 2.8,
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.45,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    # stat_summary(
    #   fun = mean,
    #   geom = "point",
    #   shape = 21,
    #   size = 2.6,
    #   fill = "black",
    #   color = "black",
    #   stroke = 0.3
    # ) +
    facet_grid(. ~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(20, y_top)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(outfile, p, width = 10.5, height = 4.2)
}

df <- read.delim(

## 1. 整理数据
df_plot <- df %>%
  mutate(
    cas_mean = rowMeans(select(., `cas-1`, `cas-2`, `cas-3`), na.rm = TRUE),
    cas_per_cfu_1e8 = cas_mean / CFU * 1e8,
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NaCl", "pH", "Temperature")),

  ) %>%
  mutate(

## A. 矫正前：cas_mean
```

## 7.6 Isolate-level siderophore screening

```{r isolate-siderophore-screening}
  library(ape)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(dplyr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(grid)
  
 
  # 1. read data

  tr <- read.tree(
    "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/metagenome/50-culture/16s-50.culture.nwk"
  )
  
  dat1 <- read.delim(
    "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/metagenome/50-culture/16s-culture_idlabel.txt",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  cas_dat <- read.delim(
    "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/16s/metagenome/50-culture/50.cas.txt",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # 只保留树上有的样本
  dat1 <- dat1 %>% filter(ID %in% tr$tip.label)
  cas_dat <- cas_dat %>% filter(ID %in% tr$tip.label)
  
  
  # 2. genus grouping
 
  dat1$genus_grouped <- case_when(
    dat1$genus %in% c("Arthrobacter") ~ "Arthrobacter",
    dat1$genus %in% c("Pseudarthrobacter") ~ "Pseudarthrobacter",
    dat1$genus %in% c("Bacillus_A", "Bacillus_I", "Bacillus") ~ "Bacillus_A",
    dat1$genus %in% c("Microbacterium") ~ "Microbacterium",
    dat1$genus %in% c("Paenibacillus", "Peribacillus") ~ "Peribacillus",
    dat1$genus %in% c("Sinorhizobium") ~ "Sinorhizobium",
    dat1$genus %in% c("Streptomyces") ~ "Streptomyces",
    TRUE ~ "Other genus"
  )
  
  genus_order <- c(
    "Arthrobacter",
    "Bacillus_A",
    "Microbacterium",
    "Peribacillus",
    "Sinorhizobium",
    "Streptomyces",
    "Other genus"
  )
  
  dat1$genus_grouped <- factor(dat1$genus_grouped, levels = genus_order)
  
  
  # 3. color palette
 
  genus_cols <- c(
    "Arthrobacter"   = "#D81B60",
    "Bacillus_A"     = "#7CAE00",
    "Microbacterium" = "#1B9E77",
    "Peribacillus"   = "#F564E3",
    "Sinorhizobium"  = "#E67E22",
    "Streptomyces"   = "#8E44AD",
    "Other genus"    = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  
  dat1$significant <- factor(dat1$significant, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  
  sig_cols <- c(
    "No"  = "#D9D9D9",
    "Yes" = "#1B9E77"
  )
  
  
  # 4. group tree
 
  group_list <- split(dat1$ID, dat1$genus_grouped)
  tr2 <- groupOTU(tr, group_list)
  
  
  # 5. CAS summary
 
  cas_sum <- cas_dat %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    summarise(
      cas_mean = mean(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      cas_sd   = sd(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  dat1_plot <- dat1 %>%
    left_join(cas_sum, by = "ID")
  
 
  # 6. base tree
  
  p_tree <- ggtree(
    tr2,
    layout = "rectangular",
    aes(color = group),
    size = 0.75
  ) +
    geom_tiplab(
      aes(label = label),
      size = 4.3,
      offset = 0.015,
      align = TRUE,
      linetype = "dotted",
      linesize = 0.85,
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_treescale(x = 0.5, y = 22, width = 0.05, fontsize = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = genus_cols,
      breaks = genus_order,
      limits = genus_order,
      name = "Genus",
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.4))
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.16, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 2, 5, 5, "mm"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  
  # 7. tip positions
  
  tip_pos <- p_tree$data %>%
    dplyr::filter(isTip) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(ID = label, ypos = y)
  
  dat1_plot2 <- dat1_plot %>%
    left_join(tip_pos, by = "ID")
  
  cas_plot <- cas_dat %>%
    left_join(tip_pos, by = "ID")
  
  y_rng <- range(tip_pos$ypos) + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  
 
  # 8. priority strains panel
 
  p_sig <- ggplot(dat1_plot2, aes(x = 1, y = ypos, fill = significant)) +
    geom_tile(
      width = 0.9,
      height = 0.9,
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = sig_cols,
      breaks = c("No", "Yes"),
      limits = c("No", "Yes"),
      name = "Priority strains"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_rng, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 2, 5, 2, "mm")
    )
  

  # 9. custom horizontal boxplot stats
 
  box_stats <- cas_plot %>%
    group_by(ID, ypos) %>%
    summarise(
      q1       = quantile(cas, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      med      = median(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3       = quantile(cas, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr      = IQR(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      minv     = min(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      maxv     = max(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      cas_mean = mean(cas, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      low_bound  = q1 - 1.5 * iqr,
      high_bound = q3 + 1.5 * iqr,
      low  = max(cas_plot$cas[cas_plot$ID == ID & cas_plot$cas >= low_bound], na.rm = TRUE),
      high = min(cas_plot$cas[cas_plot$ID == ID & cas_plot$cas <= high_bound], na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  box_stats$low[!is.finite(box_stats$low)]   <- box_stats$minv[!is.finite(box_stats$low)]
  box_stats$high[!is.finite(box_stats$high)] <- box_stats$maxv[!is.finite(box_stats$high)]
  
 
  # 10. CAS panel
  
  box_h <- 0.32
  cap_h <- 0.14
  
  p_cas <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(x = low, xend = q1, y = ypos, yend = ypos),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(x = q3, xend = high, y = ypos, yend = ypos),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(x = low, xend = low, y = ypos - cap_h, yend = ypos + cap_h),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(x = high, xend = high, y = ypos - cap_h, yend = ypos + cap_h),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(
        xmin = q1, xmax = q3,
        ymin = ypos - box_h, ymax = ypos + box_h
      ),
      fill = "grey88",
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(x = med, xend = med, y = ypos - box_h, yend = ypos + box_h),
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(x = cas_mean, y = ypos),
      size = 0.9,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_rng, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = "CAS assay", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      plot.margin  = margin(5, 5, 5, 2, "mm")
    )
  
 
  # 11. combine
 
    p_tree + p_sig + p_cas +
    plot_layout(widths = c(0.6, 0.01, 0.2), guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  

  
  
  ggsave(filename = "~/Desktop/replot/culture/siderophore-experi/plot-data/50-tree-cas.pdf", width = 12,height = 12)
```

```{r DFOE-concentration}
 library(ggplot2)
 library(dplyr)
  
  data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/data-plot/5_10_deof_tar.txt',

  # Rename groups

                              "1*"  = "1x inoculum",
                              "2*" = "2x inoculum")
  
  data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = c("NC", "1x inoculum", "2x inoculum"))
  
  # day 保持数值型，方便画连续趋势线
  data$day <- as.numeric(as.character(data$day))
  

  # Colors
  # for box plot
  mycolors <- c(
    "NC" = "#E64B35FF",
    "1x inoculum" = "#9BDDE5",
    "2x inoculum" = "#00BCD4"
  )
  # for line plot
  mycolors <- c(
    "NC" = "#E64B35FF",
    "1x inoculum" = "#00acc1",
    "2x inoculum" = "#006064"
  )
  
  
  # Summary: mean ± SE
  
  sum_df <- data %>%
    group_by(day, group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(Con, na.rm = TRUE),
      se   = sd(Con, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Con))),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  
  # Plot
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # raw points
    geom_point(
      data = data,
      aes(x = day, y = Con, color = group),

      alpha = 0.45,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # trend line
    geom_line(
      data = sum_df,
      aes(x = day, y = mean, color = group, group = group),
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    # error bar
    geom_errorbar(
      data = sum_df,
      aes(
        x = day,
        ymin = mean - se,
        ymax = mean + se,
        color = group
      ),
      width = 3.5,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    # mean point
    geom_point(
      data = sum_df,
      aes(x = day, y = mean, fill = group, color = group),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3.2,
      stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mycolors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 21, 42, 63, 120),
      limits = c(-5, 125),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0), add = c(0.0003, 0.001))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "DFOE concentration",
      color = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    ) +

      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  p

  library(dplyr)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)
  library(emmeans)
  
  data <- read.delim(
    '~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/data-plot/ks-3-10.txt',
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
    header = TRUE, sep = "\t"
  )
  
  data <- read.delim('~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-experiment/data-plot/5_10_deof_tar.txt',
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                     header = T, sep = "\t")
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "5*", "10*")),
      day   = factor(day, levels = c(0, 21, 42, 63, 120)),
      order = factor(order),
      rep_id = interaction(group, order, drop = TRUE)
    )
  
  # mixed model
  fit_lmm <- lmer(Con ~ group * day + (1 | rep_id), data = data)
  
  anova(fit_lmm)
  summary(fit_lmm)
  
  
  emm1 <- emmeans(fit_lmm, ~ group | day)
  pairs(emm1, adjust = "BH")
  
  plot(fit_lmm)
  qqnorm(resid(fit_lmm))
  qqline(resid(fit_lmm))
  
  shapiro.test(resid(fit_lmm))
```

```{r siderophore-element-mobilization}
  library(dplyr)

      group   = factor(group, levels = c("NC", "WT-5", "WT-10")),
      day     = factor(day, levels = c(21, 42, 63, 120)),

 # 按元素逐个做重复测量模型
  #推荐版：nlme::lm
  
  library(nlme)
  library(emmeans)
  library(purrr)
  library(broom.mixed)
  #install.packages('broom.mixed')
  
  fit_one_element <- function(ele, dat) {
    subdat <- dat %>% filter(element == ele)
    
    fit <- lme(
      value ~ group * day,
      random = ~1 | rep_id,
      correlation = corAR1(form = ~ day_num | rep_id),
      data = subdat,
      method = "REML"
    )
    
    anova_tab <- anova(fit) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
      mutate(element = ele)
    
    emm_group_by_day <- emmeans(fit, ~ group | day)
    pair_group_by_day <- pairs(emm_group_by_day, adjust = "BH") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(element = ele, contrast_type = "group_within_day")
    
    emm_day_by_group <- emmeans(fit, ~ day | group)
    pair_day_by_group <- pairs(emm_day_by_group, adjust = "BH") %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(element = ele, contrast_type = "day_within_group")
    
    list(
      fit = fit,
      anova = anova_tab,
      pair_group_by_day = pair_group_by_day,
      pair_day_by_group = pair_day_by_group
    )
  }
  
  elements <- levels(df_long$element)
  
  res_list <- map(elements, fit_one_element, dat = df_long)
  names(res_list) <- elements
  
  anova_all <- bind_rows(map(res_list, "anova"))
  pair_group_day_all <- bind_rows(map(res_list, "pair_group_by_day"))
  pair_day_group_all <- bind_rows(map(res_list, "pair_day_by_group"))  
  
  View(pair_group_day_all)
```

# 8. Siderophore-associated patterns across the field chronosequence

## 8.1 FeGenie siderophore-associated genes

```{r field-fegenie-genes}
# DNA-scaled
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)


# 1. Paths


data_dir <- "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-isolation/strain/fegenie_summary/independent315_summary"
out_dir  <- file.path(data_dir, "figures")

dir.create(
  out_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

master_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "FeGenie_independent315_sample_master.tsv"
)

rpkm_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "FeGenie_independent315_centroid_RPKM_matrix.tsv"
)

family_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "FeGenie_centroid_to_family.tsv"
)

# 2. Metadata


metadata <- read.table(
  "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-isolation/strain/metadata.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- as_tibble(metadata[, 1:4])

names(metadata) <- c(
  "SeqID",
  "DNA",
  "Group_raw",
  "Type"
)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    SeqID = as.character(SeqID),
    DNA = as.numeric(DNA),
    Type = trimws(Type),
    Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(Group_raw)
    ),
    Analysis_group = case_when(
      Type == "SD" ~ "SD",
      Type == "SI" &
        Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17) ~
        as.character(Group_numeric),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Analysis_group = factor(
      Analysis_group,
      levels = c("SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17")
    ),
    plot_x = if_else(
      Type == "SD",
      10,
      Group_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  )

# 3. Sample-level results


master <- read.delim(
  master_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

names(master)[1] <- "sample"

master <- master %>%
  mutate(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    SeqID = str_extract(sample, "^[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = "SeqID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_RPKM = as.numeric(
      siderophore_total_RPKM
    ),
    family_richness = as.numeric(
      siderophore_detected_HMM_richness
    ),
    
    # Scale relative gene abundance by DNA concentration
    DNA_scaled_total_RPKM = total_RPKM * DNA,
    
    # Response used for statistical analysis and plotting
    abundance_value = asinh(
      DNA_scaled_total_RPKM
    )
  )


# 4. Centroid RPKM and family classification

centroid_RPKM <- read.delim(
  rpkm_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

names(centroid_RPKM)[1] <- "sample"

family_map <- read.delim(
  family_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

names(family_map)[1:2] <- c(
  "centroid",
  "gene_family"
)

family_map <- family_map %>%
  mutate(
    gene_family = str_remove(
      gene_family,
      "-family-siderophore-synthesis$"
    ),
    synthesis_system = case_when(
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Pvd") ~
        "Pyoverdine-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Pch") ~
        "Pyochelin-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Pvs") ~
        "Vibrioferrin-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Rhb") ~
        "Rhizobactin-associated synthesis",
      
      str_detect(gene_family, "^Iuc") ~
        "Aerobactin-associated synthesis",
      
      TRUE ~
        "Other siderophore synthesis systems"
    )
  )

centroid_names <- intersect(
  names(centroid_RPKM),
  family_map$centroid
)

cat(
  "Matched reference genes:",
  length(centroid_names),
  "\n"
)


# 5. Sum RPKM by siderophore synthesis system


system_RPKM <- centroid_RPKM %>%
  select(
    sample,
    all_of(centroid_names)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(centroid_names),
    names_to = "centroid",
    values_to = "RPKM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RPKM = replace_na(
      as.numeric(RPKM),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    family_map %>%
      select(
        centroid,
        synthesis_system
      ),
    by = "centroid"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    synthesis_system
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    system_RPKM = sum(
      RPKM,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

system_names <- sort(
  unique(family_map$synthesis_system)
)

system_RPKM <- system_RPKM %>%
  complete(
    sample = unique(master$sample),
    synthesis_system = system_names,
    fill = list(system_RPKM = 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    master %>%
      select(
        sample,
        SeqID,
        DNA,
        Type,
        Analysis_group,
        Group_numeric,
        plot_x
      ),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Scale relative gene abundance by DNA concentration
    DNA_scaled_system_RPKM = system_RPKM * DNA,
    
    # Response used for statistical analysis and plotting
    system_value = asinh(
      DNA_scaled_system_RPKM
    ),
    
    synthesis_system = factor(
      synthesis_system,
      levels = c(
        "Pyoverdine-associated synthesis",
        "Pyochelin-associated synthesis",
        "Vibrioferrin-associated synthesis",
        "Rhizobactin-associated synthesis",
        "Aerobactin-associated synthesis",
        "Other siderophore synthesis systems"
      )
    )
  )


# 6. GLM functions
#    Only SI samples from restoration years 11–17 are modeled
#    DNA is incorporated into the response and is therefore
#    not included as a model covariate.


glm_statistics <- function(data, response, metric) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(.data[[response]])
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    reformulate(
      "Group_numeric",
      response = response
    ),
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  tidy(
    model,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      term == "Group_numeric"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      metric = metric,
      n = nrow(model_data),
      GLM_beta_per_year = estimate,
      standard_error = std.error,
      confidence_interval_lower = conf.low,
      confidence_interval_upper = conf.high,
      P_value = p.value
    )
}


glm_prediction <- function(data, response) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(.data[[response]])
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    reformulate(
      "Group_numeric",
      response = response
    ),
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  prediction_data <- tibble(
    Group_numeric = seq(
      11,
      17,
      length.out = 100
    )
  )
  
  prediction <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    se.fit = TRUE
  )
  
  prediction_data %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = as.numeric(prediction$fit),
      lower = fitted -
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit),
      upper = fitted +
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit)
    )
}


# 7. GLM statistics


overall_statistics <- bind_rows(
  glm_statistics(
    master,
    "abundance_value",
    paste(
      "DNA-scaled total siderophore",
      "biosynthesis gene abundance"
    )
  ),
  glm_statistics(
    master,
    "family_richness",
    paste(
      "Number of detected siderophore",
      "biosynthesis gene families"
    )
  )
)

system_statistics <- system_RPKM %>%
  group_by(
    synthesis_system
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ glm_statistics(
      .x,
      "system_value",
      as.character(.y$synthesis_system)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

statistics_table <- bind_rows(
  overall_statistics,
  system_statistics
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trend = case_when(
      GLM_beta_per_year < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      GLM_beta_per_year > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  statistics_table,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "Independent315_DNA_scaled_RPKM_GLM_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

print(
  statistics_table,
  n = Inf
)
```

## 8.2 F8 DFOE-associated gene homologues

```{r field-dfoe-gene-homologues}

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)


# 1. Files

setwd(
  "/Users/chenqiong/Desktop/replot/culture/field-isolation/strain"
)

master_file <- paste0(
  "independent18_summary/",
  "DFOE_independent18_sample_master.tsv"
)

output_dir <- "independent18_summary/figures"

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# 2. Metadata

metadata <- read.table(
  "metadata.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- as_tibble(metadata[, 1:4])

names(metadata) <- c(
  "SeqID",
  "DNA",
  "Group_raw",
  "Type"
)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    SeqID = as.character(SeqID),
    DNA = as.numeric(DNA),
    Type = trimws(Type),
    Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(Group_raw)
    ),
    Analysis_group = case_when(
      Type == "SD" ~ "SD",
      Type == "SI" &
        Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17) ~
        as.character(Group_numeric),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Analysis_group = factor(
      Analysis_group,
      levels = c("SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17")
    ),
    plot_x = if_else(
      Type == "SD",
      10,
      Group_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  )

# 3. DFOE results

dfoe <- read.delim(
  master_file,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    SeqID = str_extract(sample, "^[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = "SeqID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Analysis_group),
    !is.na(DNA)
  )


# 4. Long-format plotting data


metric_labels <- c(
  "00626_total_RPKM" =
    "ddc-like",
  
  "00627_total_RPKM" =
    "iucD-like",
  
  "00628_total_RPKM" =
    "bibC-like",
  
  "max_core3_mean_RPKM" =
    "Collinear three-gene module"
)

plot_data <- dfoe %>%
  select(
    sample,
    SeqID,
    DNA,
    Type,
    Analysis_group,
    Group_numeric,
    plot_x,
    all_of(names(metric_labels))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(metric_labels)),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "RPKM"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RPKM = replace_na(
      as.numeric(RPKM),
      0
    ),
    
    # Scale relative abundance by DNA concentration
    DNA_scaled_RPKM = RPKM * DNA,
    
    # Response variable
    plot_value = asinh(
      DNA_scaled_RPKM
    ),
    
    metric_label = recode(
      metric,
      !!!metric_labels
    ),
    
    metric_label = factor(
      metric_label,
      levels = unname(metric_labels)
    )
  )



# 5. GLM
#    DNA is incorporated into the response and is therefore
#    not included as a model covariate.


fit_GLM <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(plot_value)
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    plot_value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  result <- tidy(
    model,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      term == "Group_numeric"
    )
  
  tibble(
    n_SI = nrow(model_data),
    GLM_beta_per_year = result$estimate,
    standard_error = result$std.error,
    confidence_interval_lower = result$conf.low,
    confidence_interval_upper = result$conf.high,
    P_value = result$p.value
  )
}

statistics_table <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    metric_label
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ fit_GLM(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trend = case_when(
      GLM_beta_per_year < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      GLM_beta_per_year > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  statistics_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "DFOE_independent18_DNA_scaled_RPKM_GLM_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

print(
  statistics_table,
  n = Inf
)

# 6. GLM prediction lines


make_prediction <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Type == "SI",
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(plot_value)
    )
  
  model <- glm(
    plot_value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  prediction_data <- tibble(
    Group_numeric = seq(
      11,
      17,
      length.out = 100
    )
  )
  
  prediction <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = prediction_data,
    se.fit = TRUE
  )
  
  prediction_data %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = as.numeric(
        prediction$fit
      ),
      lower = fitted -
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit),
      upper = fitted +
        1.96 * as.numeric(prediction$se.fit)
    )
}

prediction_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(
    metric,
    metric_label
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ make_prediction(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r DFOE-field-concentarion}
   # 仅分析11–17年的恢复趋势
   si <- df %>% filter(group != "SD")
   
   # 1. 线性趋势
   fit <- lm(con ~ year, data = si)
   fit_sum <- summary(fit)$coefficients
   
   trend_result <- tibble(
     test = "Linear trend (11–17 years)",
     estimate_per_year = fit_sum["year", "Estimate"],
     standard_error = fit_sum["year", "Std. Error"],
     p_value = fit_sum["year", "Pr(>|t|)"]
   )
   
   trend_result
   # 2. Spearman趋势
   sp <- cor.test(si$year, si$con, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
   
   spearman_result <- tibble(
     test = "Spearman trend (11–17 years)",
     estimate_per_year = unname(sp$estimate),
     standard_error = NA_real_,
     p_value = sp$p.value
   )
   
   # 3. 11–17年各组总体差异
   kw <- kruskal.test(con ~ group, data = si)
   
   kruskal_result <- tibble(
     test = "Kruskal–Wallis test (11–17 years)",
     estimate_per_year = NA_real_,
     standard_error = NA_real_,
     p_value = kw$p.value
   )
   
   statistics_table <- bind_rows(
     trend_result,
     spearman_result,
     kruskal_result
   ) %>%
     mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
   
   print(statistics_table)
   write_tsv(statistics_table, "DFOE_field_statistics.tsv")
   
   # 4. 各恢复年份两两比较
   pairwise_result <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
     x = si$con,
     g = si$group,
     p.adjust.method = "BH",
     exact = FALSE
   )
   
   pairwise_table <- as.data.frame(as.table(pairwise_result$p.value)) %>%
     filter(!is.na(Freq)) %>%
     rename(
       group_1 = Var1,
       group_2 = Var2,
       adjusted_p_value = Freq
     )
   
   print(pairwise_table)
   write_tsv(pairwise_table, "DFOE_field_pairwise_comparisons.tsv")
   
   # 5. SD与全部恢复样本比较
   sd_si <- wilcox.test(
     con ~ ifelse(group == "SD", "SD", "Restored"),
     data = df,
     exact = FALSE
   )
   
   sd_comparison <- tibble(
     comparison = "SD vs restored sites",
     p_value = sd_si$p.value
   )
   
   print(sd_comparison)
   write_tsv(sd_comparison, "DFOE_SD_vs_restored.tsv")
```

```{r Field-extractable elements}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)


# 1. Files and parameters


input_file <- paste0(
  "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-84-2020/",
  "dtpa-field.txt"
)

  "~/Desktop/replot/culture/field-84-2020/",

)

  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

group_levels <- c(
  "SD", "11", "12", "14", "15", "17"
)

element_cols <- c(
  "Al", "Ca", "Cd", "Cr", "Cu", "Fe",
  "K", "Mg", "Mn", "Mo", "Na", "Ni",
  "P", "Pb", "S", "Sb", "Sn", "Zn"
)
 
element_cols <- c(
  "Fe", "Al", "Mn",
  "Ca", "Mg", "K", "Na",
  "P", "S",
  "Zn", "Cu", "Ni", "Mo", "Cr",
  "Cd", "Pb", "Sb", "Sn"
)


# 2. Read data

mydata <- read.delim(
  input_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t"
)

element_cols <- intersect(
  element_cols,
  colnames(mydata)
)

cat(
  "Elements included:",
  paste(element_cols, collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)

mydata2 <- mydata %>%
  mutate(
    group = trimws(as.character(group)),
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      as.numeric
    )
  )


# 3. Blank correction

blank_data <- mydata2 %>%
  filter(
    toupper(group) == "BLANK"
  )

if (nrow(blank_data) == 0) {
  stop("No BLANK samples were found in the group column.")
}

blank_mean <- blank_data %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

df_blank_corrected <- mydata2 %>%
  filter(
    toupper(group) != "BLANK"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      ~ .x - blank_mean[[cur_column()]]
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(element_cols),
      ~ case_when(
        is.na(.x) ~ NA_real_,
        .x < 0 ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ .x
      )
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  df_blank_corrected,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "dtpa-field-blank-corrected.tsv"
  )
)


# 4. Long-format plotting data


df_long <- df_blank_corrected %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = group_levels
    ),
    Group_numeric = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(group))
    ),
    plot_x = if_else(
      as.character(group) == "SD",
      10,
      Group_numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(element_cols),
    names_to = "element",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.numeric(value),
    element = factor(
      element,
      levels = element_cols
    )
  )

# 5. GLM statistics
#    Only restoration years 11–17 are modeled.
#    SD is displayed but is not included in the GLM.


fit_GLM <- function(data) {
  
  model_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      Group_numeric %in% c(11, 12, 14, 15, 17),
      !is.na(Group_numeric),
      is.finite(value)
    )
  
  if (
    nrow(model_data) < 3 ||
    n_distinct(model_data$Group_numeric) < 2
  ) {
    return(
      tibble(
        n_SI = nrow(model_data),
        GLM_beta_per_year = NA_real_,
        standard_error = NA_real_,
        confidence_interval_lower = NA_real_,
        confidence_interval_upper = NA_real_,
        P_value = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }
  
  model <- glm(
    value ~ Group_numeric,
    data = model_data,
    family = gaussian()
  )
  
  result <- tidy(
    model,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      term == "Group_numeric"
    )
  
  tibble(
    n_SI = nrow(model_data),
    GLM_beta_per_year = result$estimate,
    standard_error = result$std.error,
    confidence_interval_lower = result$conf.low,
    confidence_interval_upper = result$conf.high,
    P_value = result$p.value
  )
}

statistics_table <- df_long %>%
  group_by(
    element
  ) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ fit_GLM(.x)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trend = case_when(
      GLM_beta_per_year < 0 ~ "Decreasing",
      GLM_beta_per_year > 0 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )

write_tsv(
  statistics_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "DTPA_elements_GLM_statistics.tsv"
  )
)

print(
```

```{r validation-particle-size}
# indoor

                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,

                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                   header = T, sep = "\t")
  

 
  
  #  可选：是否用“数目权重” 
  use_number_weighted <- FALSE  # 想用数目权重就设 TRUE
  
  plot_delta_p <- function(df, group_sel, use_number_weighted = FALSE) {
    diam_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sample","week","group"))
    
    # 长表
    long <- df %>%
      filter(group == group_sel, week %in% c(0, 12)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(diam_cols), names_to = "diameter", values_to = "p3") %>%
      mutate(diameter = as.numeric(diameter)) %>%
      arrange(sample, week, diameter)
    
    # 计算“每周×直径” 的平均频率 (%)
    if (!use_number_weighted) {
      # 用原始 p3 直接归一化成频率(%)
      df_freq <- long %>%
        group_by(week, diameter) %>%
        summarise(mean_value = mean(p3), .groups = "drop") %>%
        group_by(week) %>%
        mutate(freq_percent = 100 * mean_value / sum(mean_value)) %>%
        ungroup()
    } else {
      # 把 p3 近似视作面积或体积频率；换算成“数目权重”：pN ∝ p3 / d^2
      d <- sort(unique(long$diameter))
      d2 <- d^2
      df_freq <- long %>%
        group_by(sample, week) %>%
        group_modify(~{
          p_area <- .x$p3
          p_num  <- (p_area / (d2 + 1e-12))
          p_num  <- 100 * p_num / sum(p_num)
          tibble(diameter = d, freq_percent = p_num)
        }) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        group_by(week, diameter) %>%
        summarise(freq_percent = mean(freq_percent), .groups = "drop")
    }
    
    # 宽表并计算 Δp(d) = 12w - 0w
    dp <- df_freq %>%
      select(week, diameter, freq_percent) %>%
      mutate(week = as.character(week)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = freq_percent, names_prefix = "w") %>%
      arrange(diameter) %>%
      mutate(delta_p = w12 - w0)
    
    # 画“差值曲线”
    ggplot(dp, aes(diameter, delta_p)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#D1495B") +
      # 如需对数轴就打开下一行
      # scale_x_log10()
      labs(x = "Particle diameter (nm)",
           y = expression(Delta*p~"(12 w - 0 w, %)"),
           title = paste0("Δp(d) — ", toupper(group_sel),
                          ifelse(use_number_weighted, " (Number-weighted)", ""))) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 16)
  }
  
  # 直接画 OE 与 WT 两条差值曲线 
  p_oe <- plot_delta_p(df, "oe", use_number_weighted)
  p_wt <- plot_delta_p(df, "wt", use_number_weighted)
  
  print(p_oe)
  print(p_wt)
  
  # 如要保存：
  # ggsave("delta_p_oe.png", p_oe, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  # ggsave("delta_p_wt.png", p_wt, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  
 
  library(tidyverse)
  
  # 公用：列名 / 直径网格 
  diam_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sample","week","group"))
  dgrid <- as.numeric(diam_cols)
  
  # 每样本频率（%）
  sample_freq <- function(df, group_sel, wk){
    df %>% filter(group==group_sel, week==wk) %>%
      select(all_of(diam_cols)) %>% as.matrix() %>%
      { 100 * . / rowSums(.) }
  }
  
  # 计算：原始折线 + bootstrap CI + p 值 + FDR
  boot_delta_ci_p <- function(df, group_sel, B = 4000, alpha = 0.05){
    X0  <- sample_freq(df, group_sel, 0);   n0  <- nrow(X0)
    X12 <- sample_freq(df, group_sel, 12);  n12 <- nrow(X12)
    
    # 原始折线（不平滑）
    raw <- tibble(diam = dgrid, delta_raw = colMeans(X12) - colMeans(X0))
    
    # bootstrap
    set.seed(1)
    deltas <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(B, ncol(X0)))
    for(b in seq_len(B)){
      m0  <- colMeans(X0 [sample(n0,  n0,  replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE])
      m12 <- colMeans(X12[sample(n12, n12, replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE])
      deltas[b, ] <- m12 - m0
    }
    
    mu <- colMeans(deltas)
    lo <- apply(deltas, 2, quantile, probs = alpha/2)
    hi <- apply(deltas, 2, quantile, probs = 1 - alpha/2)
    
    # 双侧 p 值：p = 2 * min(Pr[Δ>=0], Pr[Δ<=0])
    p_two <- apply(deltas, 2, function(v) 2 * min(mean(v >= 0), mean(v <= 0)))
    padj  <- p.adjust(p_two, method = "BH")
    
    ci <- tibble(
      diam = dgrid, mu = mu, lo = lo, hi = hi,
      p = p_two, padj = padj,
      sig_fdr = padj < 0.05              # 只标 FDR<0.05 的点
    )
    list(raw = raw, ci = ci)
  }
  
  # 画图：无黄色带，限制 x 到 1600；可选对数轴；自定义颜色
  plot_delta_ci <- function(df, group_sel, line_col = "#D1495B",
                            xmax = 1600, log_x = FALSE, title = ""){
    comp <- boot_delta_ci_p(df, group_sel, B = 4000)
    raw  <- comp$raw
    ci   <- comp$ci
    
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_ribbon(data = ci, aes(x = diam, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  fill = "#B0B0B0", alpha = .20) +
      geom_line(data = raw, aes(diam, delta_raw),
                color = line_col, linewidth = 1.05) +
      geom_point(data = subset(ci, sig_fdr), aes(diam, mu),
                 color = "black", size = 1.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = .3) +
      labs(x = "Particle diameter (µm)",
           y = expression(Delta*p~"(d84 − d0, %)"),
           title = title) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(dgrid), xmax)) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black")
      )
    
    if (log_x) p <- p + scale_x_log10(limits = c(min(dgrid), xmax))
    p
  }
  
  # 出图（不同颜色）
  p_oe <- plot_delta_ci(df, "oe", line_col = "#4F8FB3",
                        xmax = 1600, log_x = FALSE,
                        title = "OE — Δp(d) with bootstrap 95% CI (FDR points)")
  p_wt <- plot_delta_ci(df, "wt", line_col = "#7FA35A",
                        xmax = 1600, log_x = FALSE,
                        title = "WT — Δp(d) with bootstrap 95% CI (FDR points)")
  
  print(p_oe)

  # —— 保持已有的函数：sample_freq、boot_delta_ci_p（含 FDR 计算） ——
  # 若已在环境中，无需重复定义
  
  # 1) 计算 OE / WT 的原始折线 + CI + FDR，并打上 group 标记

  # 画图（注意 facet_wrap 使用同一个因子）

  # comp_wt <- boot_delta_ci_p(df, "wt"); write.csv(comp_wt$ci, "WT_delta_p_FDR.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  
  
 #统计
  # 安装/载入

  library(tidyverse)
  library(mgcv)
  
  # 1) 组织成“样本×粒径”的频率长表 
  diam_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("sample","week","group"))
  dgrid <- as.numeric(diam_cols)
  
  make_long_freq <- function(df, group_sel){
    df %>%
      filter(group == group_sel, week %in% c(0,12)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(diam_cols), names_to="diam", values_to="val") %>%
      mutate(diam = as.numeric(diam)) %>%
      group_by(sample, week) %>%
      mutate(freq = 100 * val / sum(val)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(logd = log10(diam),
             weekf = factor(week, levels=c(0,12)))
  }
  
  dat_oe <- make_long_freq(df, "oe")
  dat_wt <- make_long_freq(df, "wt")
  
  # 2) 拟合 GAM 并做“形状是否不同”的整体检验 
  fit_compare <- function(dat, k = 20){
    # 共同曲线（周之间仅截距差异）
    m_common <- gam(freq ~ weekf + s(logd, k=k, bs="cr"),
                    data = dat, method = "REML")
    # 分别曲线（0w/12w 各一条光滑）= factor-smooth interaction
    m_sep    <- gam(freq ~ weekf + s(logd, by = weekf, k=k, bs="cr"),
                    data = dat, method = "REML")
    # 比较：分开曲线是否显著优于共同曲线（形状不同）
    cmp <- anova(m_common, m_sep, test = "Chisq")
    list(m_common=m_common, m_sep=m_sep, cmp=cmp)
  }
  
  res_oe <- fit_compare(dat_oe, k=25)
  res_wt <- fit_compare(dat_wt, k=25)
  
  res_oe$cmp   # 查看 OE 的模型比较（看 Pr(>Chi)）
  res_wt$cmp   # 查看 WT 的模型比较
```

```{r validation-persistence-viability}
    ),

    ),

  )


# Colors

all_days  <- sort(unique(df$day))

# Theme

theme_my <- theme_bw(base_size = 15) +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, color = "black", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )


# Boxplot function

make_boxplot <- function(dat, title, ylab,
                         y_add_lower = 0.08,
                         y_add_upper = 0.18) {
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(day = factor(day, levels = sort(unique(day))))
  
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = day, y = value, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(color = group),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.78),
      width = 0.60,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(group = interaction(day, group)),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.08,
        dodge.width = 0.78
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 1.2,
      stroke = 0.3,
      fill = "#5D6568",
      color = "#363F43",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = box_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = line_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0), add = c(y_add_lower, y_add_upper))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = ylab
    ) +
    theme_my
}

# Build variables for 9 panels

    bibc_live_logratio =
      log10(`BibC-like-pma` + 1) - log10(`BibC-like-no-pma` + 1)
  )


# Analysis settings matching visualization

analysis_list <- list(
  
  # Row 1
  # p1: 0, 42, 84; 4 groups
  total_bacterial = list(
    var = "total_bacterial",
    days = c("0", "42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p2: 0, 42, 84; 4 groups
  viable_bacterial = list(
    var = "viable_bacterial",

    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p3: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  bacterial_live_logratio = list(
    var = "bacterial_live_logratio",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # Row 2
  # p4: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  total_inoculant = list(
    var = "total_inoculant",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p5: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  viable_inoculant = list(
    var = "viable_inoculant",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p6: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  inoculant_live_logratio = list(
    var = "inoculant_live_logratio",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # Row 3
  # p7: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  total_bibc = list(
    var = "total_bibc",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p8: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  viable_bibc = list(
    var = "viable_bibc",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  ),
  
  # p9: only 42, 84; 4 groups
  bibc_live_logratio = list(
    var = "bibc_live_logratio",
    days = c("42", "84"),
    groups = c("NC", "KO", "WT", "OS")
  )
)


# LMM function

run_lmm <- function(dat, response_var, keep_days, keep_groups) {
  
  subdat <- dat %>%
    filter(day %in% keep_days, group %in% keep_groups) %>%
    select(group, day, rep_id, all_of(response_var)) %>%
    rename(y = all_of(response_var)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(y), !is.na(y)) %>%
    droplevels() %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(group, levels = keep_groups),
      day = factor(day, levels = keep_days),
      rep_id = factor(rep_id)
    )
  
  fit <- lmer(
    y ~ group * day + (1 | rep_id),
    data = subdat,
    REML = FALSE
  )
  
  anova_tab <- anova(fit, type = 3) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("term")
  
  emm_all <- emmeans(fit, ~ group * day) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  group_by_day <- emmeans(fit, ~ group | day) %>%
    pairs(adjust = "BH") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  day_by_group <- emmeans(fit, ~ day | group) %>%
    pairs(adjust = "BH") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  list(
    data = subdat,
    fit = fit,
    anova = anova_tab,
    emm = emm_all,
    group_by_day = group_by_day,
    day_by_group = day_by_group
  )
}


# Run all analyses

results <- imap(
  analysis_list,
  ~ run_lmm(
    dat = df2,
    response_var = .x$var,
    keep_days = .x$days,
    keep_groups = .x$groups
  )
)


# Combine outputs

anova_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$anova, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

emm_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$emm, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

group_by_day_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$group_by_day, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

day_by_group_all <- imap_dfr(
  results,
  ~ mutate(.x$day_by_group, panel = .y),
  .id = NULL
)

# Significant results

anova_sig <- anova_all %>%
  filter(`Pr(>F)` < 0.05)

group_by_day_sig <- group_by_day_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

day_by_group_sig <- day_by_group_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)


# View outputs

anova_sig
group_by_day_sig
day_by_group_sig
```

```{r validation-surface-alteration}
    Altered_surface_fraction = mean(Altered_surface_fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
    ROI_area_um2 = mean(ROI_area_um2, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r validation-dtpa-iron}
   )
   
   # 主题
   theme_my <- theme_bw(base_size = 15) +

   baseline_df <- data %>%

       log2FC_median= log2(Fe / baseline_median)
     )
   
   # 查看计算结果

       ),

     ) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = box_colors) +
```
